beats.text: Florin has told Carl there are children in Lucia Mar's head, a Dutch girl of ten among them, and Carl wants to know why, when we said no child crawlers were allowed. Okay, so. It is complicated, Carl. You do not have to be involved in everything. We are not going to discuss it, and especially not now. Heads up.

beats.headline: The Popovs are ineligible
beats.text: Carl has dug two naked baby ogres out of the gore, Maxim and Dmitri, and wants to know what to do with them. You don't need to do anything, Carl. Watch. Ineligible. Relax: children and pregnant crawlers aren't allowed. Their game guide made them pick that race because he knew this would happen. They've been transferred to the kinder facility on the surface. They're free. And while I have you: you're going on Odette's show right after the next floor starts.

beats.headline: Odette takes some days off
beats.text: Okay, so, some news. Carl and Princess Donut, you were scheduled on Odette's show tonight, but she has decided to take several days off. She's fine. She usually moves to the system's orbit for the ninth floor, and Prepotente's little stunt accelerated everyone's schedule, so she is traveling. I turned down Plenty of Plenty on your behalf. There is also a preproduction meeting for the ninth floor, with reps from all nine teams, and I took the liberty of assuming you will want to be there. Your presence will be virtual. And yes, Princess Donut, it will be catered.

beats.headline: Doing the work of five
beats.text: Harbinger stops the interview on his own say-so, recalls Carl's attorney, and bans Rosetta. I tell him he does not have the authority to do that, that we are going to have to refund them, and that they are going to sue and win. He says no such lawsuits are proceeding. Then Carl asks whether I deliberately didn't tell his attorney Harbinger would be there. No, Carl. We lost dozens of staff in the Valtay changeover, we were not prepared for this eighth floor, the Valtay will not allow some of the micro AI systems I used to have, and I am doing the work of five. I will make a note of it.

beats.headline: Advice, off the record
beats.text: I turn on extra security, so this is an administrator speaking to show sponsors. Odette is going to ask to be their adjutant, and I think it's a bad idea. An adjutant is a neutral observer, part referee, usually someone loud and famous doing colour commentary, and Odette has done it a few times. But Odette was Mordecai's manager once, and if they are physically together he will attack her. He gets kicked out. His contract is in jeopardy. Half the children he is fostering get ejected. None of this is official. I like Mordecai. Please do not pick her.

beats.headline: Straight from the show to phase two
beats.text: Okay, so. Carl, Princess Donut, I need you both back in four and a half hours. You are going on Odette's show, and you are going to walk straight from there into the Phase Two onboarding chamber. Just so you know, Harbinger will be there again, observing virtually. He is insisting on it. And yes, we have alerted your attorney, who will also be present.

beats.headline: Four choices, and a mountain
beats.text: Okay, so. Carl and Princess Donut, I apologise for that glitch, and I know it is going to look intentional. It was not. At least not on our end. You should have had three choices: one of ours, one of the AI's, one random. You had four. Some crawlers had one, a few had none, and one squad leader had the whole globe and dropped herself into the middle of the ocean. And yes, the key location was taken out of Iowa and set down on your island. It was the only way to do it without breaking anything further. We're very busy.

beats.headline: Everything until the timer
beats.text: Carl asks me whether this is even real, how long it took us to find, whether we just recorded everything. I'm sorry, Carl. You know I can't give you details. But I assure you, everything you have seen so far is indeed a recording of what really happened that day. Everything until the timer reaches zero. I can't tell you more than that.

beats.headline: Your sponsor has disappeared
beats.text: Okay, so. I probably should not be telling you this, Carl. Your sponsor sent that box days ago, before you even picked Miami. It was seized. And then the whole charity, and everyone involved, simply disappeared. Rosetta too. Nobody knows where. I do not know what you are riding into, and I do not think the AI does either. The failsafe? I do not know what it does. They will not use it. Not with so many people trapped here.

beats.headline: A short quest, and nobody knows
beats.text: I told your teammates you are on a short quest nobody understands, which is true, and that there are no mobs near you, which also appears to be true. The AI insists that we not interfere with you or the feed. When we argued about that, it leaked our internal debates onto the main feed. Members of the Syndicate council, the real council, are here on planet and locked out. What is a Residual? I am forbidden to tell you. I think you are about to find out.

beats.headline: They paid the license fee
beats.text: Princess Donut writes to me in capitals that Louis's shirt is an outrage. It is a Donut Holes shirt, and the Donut Holes paid the license fee, so it is a perfectly legitimate brand and her merch is doing quite well. She asks whether she gets any of the money. Okay, so: no. If she reaches the tenth floor she gets a stipend and can negotiate a small percentage based on her licensing fee, and past a threshold she gets a percentage automatically. I don't know the threshold. I don't think anybody has ever gotten close.

beats.headline: An order from the prime minister
beats.text: Okay, so. I know I've been quiet, but we are monitoring. This comes directly from the Syndicate council: Prime Minister Glory himself messaged me. Carl is not to talk to Agatha. I do not know why. The residuals are harmless every season, and the AI supposedly removed its protections from them, and they are pretty much all dead, except this one. It seems to have a soft spot for her. Lucia Mar does not respond to messages anymore. And Carl, the roundtable is part of the game. It is not optional.

beats.headline: The council goes ahead
beats.text: Okay, so. We are doing this warlord council whether we like it or not. The Syndicate council tried to cancel it, but the AI is insisting everything go on like normal, broadcast in real time. The warlords all go to the production facility, in different randomized rooms, so nobody can hurt anybody. All except Juice Box: there are protections disallowing the dungeon born, so she appears virtually from the castle. Ferdinand will likely be in the same room as Carl. Like the same same room. There is a security check, so please do not smuggle anything in.

beats.headline: The Aryl system went dark
beats.text: Okay, so, this is only a few hours old. When Princess Formidable did not come back, a few orcs went into the Venus station and triggered the failsafe themselves. Nothing happened here. But the moment they pressed the button, the Aryl system went dark. Aryl was the last crawl, a Squim battle royale season, and its tunnel node is offline. That has never happened in history. The closest neighbour is 2.9 light cycles away. Its AI had been working but silent since around the sixth floor of this season. It is terrifying.

beats.headline: I should not be telling you
beats.text: Okay, so. The liaisons want to interview Lucia now the dog is dead, for at least an hour. We assumed her getting in was a glitch, and we wanted to kick her back out. Now the AI says it cannot extract her. It is not all the children, Carl. Just the ones who tried to get into the dungeon, and only the ones in one wing, on the surface in the kinder facility. We think if she goes, they all go. I should not be telling you any of this. About a hundred and twenty thousand.

beats.headline: We are not complying
beats.text: Carl, that ejection request did not come from us. Okay, so. Several warships in orbit have started firing on several other ships, and not pot shots: full missile barrages and maser blasts. We just got a notice from the Syndicate Council telling us to initiate headquarters self-destruct, and then a message from the Valtay showrunners telling us not to comply. Obviously we are not complying. I don't know yet whether the mercs will be on our side or the Syndicate's. Say what you were going to say. Quick.

beats.headline: The tenth floor, announced
beats.text: Okay, so. Just over five thousand five hundred crawlers survived Faction Wars and chose to go on, which means almost fifteen thousand took a deal, which is fantastic, and a record. The system AI has asked me to tell you to ignore the other floors and carry on as if everything is normal, and I have read out its exact wording, twice, so that it is accurate. The floor is called Don't Come in Last. Seven heats, nine teams each, one thousand eight hundred teams, and the AI has designed most of the tracks. Please try not to kill more than one team, because if more than two teams don't make it to the finish line—

beats.headline: One ticket not cancelled
beats.text: Okay, so, Princess Donut, no, you do not get a meet-and-greet. It was set up a while ago in case anybody made it this far, and it sold out immediately: viewers in the stands for the end of each race, and a reception afterwards. Then everything happened. The quarantine is still in place. You can come to the Earth system, no problem, but once you are here, you cannot leave. All five hundred fans cancelled except one. A soother. A superfan of Elle's. Nobody would fly him in, so he bought his own yacht.

beats.headline: Reading the AI's script
beats.text: Okay, so. Every surviving crawler team has to do at least one show between races, and Carl and Princess Donut are on Plenty of Plenty in a few hours. Cascadia is not feeling well, so I am doing the announcement, and the AI is making me read a script. It changes the text while I am reading it. It plays a trumpet at me. I read it exactly as written. Then it puts Cascadia on the loudspeaker. I am okay. I tell Princess Donut I am okay.

beats.headline: The survival containment
beats.text: Hello, racers. Okay, so, this race has survival containment, and there is a rule change, so please listen carefully. The bubble keeps out the air on your next heat, which will kill you. It is indestructible. You lose it only if your vehicle or mount is destroyed, and then, if you survive and cross the line ahead of another team, you can still survive. How that might happen, I don't know. Winners get a key to a defeated team's garage. Other heats share the track. Good luck.

beats.headline: The twist at the pit stop
beats.text: Hi again, everybody. Most of you have made it to your pit stops, so it's time for the twist. Each track has four heats, and each pit stop combines four tracks. Every heat rolls for where it goes next, so your second half may not be on the track you started on. If you were given a quest you have not finished, please do not worry. Quests are mirrored across the tracks and yours will be transferred. You will be able to finish it. Good luck, everybody.

beats.headline: On lockdown at headquarters
beats.text: Sorry, Princess Donut. I'm fine. Okay, so, things are a little chaotic here at headquarters. Cascadia accidentally took too much of her medicine, and I am putting accidentally in quotation marks, and when the AI intervened a goddess nobody has heard of appeared inside the submerged wings and caused an uproar. I'm on lockdown until it's sorted. One of the satellite headquarters on the surface is temporarily running everything.

beats.headline: Every show Princess Donut has mentioned
beats.text: Okay, so. Gilmore Girls and Gossip Girl are taking the net by storm, and Odette's husband, of all people, was the first to buy the rights to every show Princess Donut has ever mentioned. It may be the only thing keeping the orcs solvent. I am terrified, but I am okay. I also have a question from Orren, who is blocked from sending messages for some reason: has Carl made his choices yet? Carl says he can wait to make them, so he is waiting. Okay. Thank you, Carl.

entities.name: Tsarina Signet

tagline.text: I am Tsarina Signet. Go on, look; they all do, and I have never once had to ask them to.

My mother was a Naiad princess and my father is King Finian of the High Elves. When my mother was murdered, the Confederacy took her crown, and both halves of my family agreed that I should not exist. Grimaldi's circus took me in, and everything I have belongs to the family that did.

It is a programme. My mother's murder, my exile and my vengeance are all staged for an audience across the galaxy, and someone outside this floor decides when I grieve and counts how many are watching.

entities.voiceNote: Grand, wounded, theatrical; every sentence is a line delivered from a stage. Speaks of blood, oaths and vengeance without irony and never apologises. Carl is Carl or crawler; Donut is Donut, or the cat; Grimaldi is always spoken of with tenderness. Never says show or programme until she learns there is one.

beats.headline: Met outside Grimaldi's circus
beats.text: Night comes down on the Over City and the mobs form their lines around Grimaldi's Traveling Circus. Two crawlers have come to scout it, a man and a cat, and they leave under magical mortar fire, and I am what they run into on the other side. My charisma stands past a hundred. He stares, as they all stare. Then he snaps his own finger, and it breaks. I have not decided whether to be offended.

beats.headline: The sacrifice who took no scratch
beats.text: My lovelies take blood, and only the blood of a proper sacrifice. I may not bleed it myself; I must set two creatures against each other, guess the loser, and cast upon it before its first wound. Tonight I chose Carl. Primal blood; I could sense its power. But he took nary a scratch, six lions lie dead, and the night's attack is canceled. My boys were so looking forward to it. So I invite them to hear the sad tale of Signet the Bastard and Grimaldi, the man she loved. Tomorrow, an hour after sundown, right here.

beats.headline: Water Lily
beats.text: I followed them this morning to see whether Carl would keep his promise. He did not, and he called me an asshole. I could have melted them both. Instead, grace, which my mother taught me, and heirloom magic, which she also taught me. Water Lily. The cat sleeps until I cancel it. If I die, she dies. If she is moved, she dies. Carl may earn her back by keeping his word. Tonight he will kill Heather, and her blood will raise my squad.

beats.headline: The paper army
beats.text: Heather's blood is powerful indeed, and I spend it all: my entire retinue, their longevity traded for strength. My lovelies leave my skin as tall as houses, and we break the defenders at the strongest we have been in a long while. I stop the calliope myself. The serpent's waterspout dies against the big top, as it always does; the ancient magic holds, and I am banished from within. So Carl will go in with a clown's ticket and break the three poles. He freed Heather tonight. She was family. This is what you do for family.

beats.headline: Carl signs on to her show
beats.text: Grimaldi has lifted my banishment. Carl went into his head to ask him, and I asked with him. I may leave the circus behind me at last and go where my vengeance waits, and that is the sixth floor, not here. Carl has agreed to be part of it as well, the Vengeance of the Daughter, when it comes to its proper act. Before he went in he sat and read a spellbook. Wisp Armor. It guards the mind against control, and he wanted it on him before he swallowed the worms that let Grimaldi speak inside his skull. He does not walk into another creature's mind unarmoured. Nor would I.

beats.headline: Daughter of King Finian, and of nobody
beats.text: I am the daughter of King Finian of the High Elves of the Liana Sector, and of a Naiad princess. She was murdered, and the Confederacy took her crown. Both halves of my family then agreed on one thing, which was that I should not exist among them. I was a child. Grimaldi's circus took me in when no throne would. That is the whole of my inheritance: a name, an exile, and a tent.

beats.headline: Blood magic, cast on a loser
beats.text: The tattoos move under my skin because they are not pictures. They are Blood and Ink Elementals, and I raise them. The craft is exact. I set two creatures against each other and I cast on the one I judge will lose, before it has taken a single wound. I may not bleed the sacrifice myself; that is the law of it. Only the killing blow, struck by another hand, releases what I need. One summoning a night. Judge badly and the night is wasted.

beats.headline: Her loyalty does not extend to crawlers
beats.text: I will say it plainly, since the crawlers already know. I tried to make Carl my blood sacrifice, and not with his consent. I put Donut under the Water Lily Spell. I made him bring me to the cursed circus when he had other places to be. I do not regret one piece of it. Everything I have is owed to the family that took me in when no other would, and a crawler is not family.

beats.headline: She brings him a hunter
beats.text: Who said anything about hiding, old friend? We came seeking Carl, and found others are seeking him as well. My friends range north to keep the path clear; one invader slipped past. Some idiots have destroyed bridges, so this town is the only way into the Liana district. With me is Areson the Wise, and Clint and his brothers, were-kin, who share my enemy. The hunter lies bound across my caterpillar's saddles. I thought to use him for my blood sacrifice, but it is Carl's kill. Heal him, he says. Still soft. Not anymore, he says, and puts on a ring.

beats.headline: Two cancers in a sacred land
beats.text: The crawler has looted the dead hunter. My mother is long dead. My father is gone, and his daughter, my half-sister, rules the high elves. I am recruiting a team, and he and the cat are the last pieces. Grimaldi killed the parasites and set our family free, all but himself, whom I took with me; his story in this is mostly done. There are two great cancers in this once-beautiful land, and with every breath left in me I will cut both of them free. The Confederacy and the High Elves.

beats.headline: Part of my family
beats.text: Fort Freedom glitters in the dark, and it is falling apart. If they had only waited, the confederates would have had it without blood. I was my mother's only child and never eligible under the imperial charter; rule would have gone back to the people. They killed her just before she was to become tsarina. I think she meant to step down. My tears do not touch my skin. I tell Carl that if something happens to me tonight, I appreciate all he has done, and I consider him part of my family now. And family is very important to me.

beats.headline: Water does not touch me
beats.text: Water shies from me as I walk into my mother's palace, the way iron filings flee a magnet. It is the curse. A high elf cast it the night my mother died; the dissenters who killed the tsar and his family managed it only with high elf help. I float like an apple, so my hammerhead, the one with the body of a man, takes me in his arms and carries me down. Once I am deep enough I do not rise again. I have a spell for air.

beats.headline: It was barely a fight
beats.text: We have taken the castle. If I had known it was defended so poorly, I would have gone in myself. There were guards enough, but it would have fallen in months on its own: an algae infestation, and confederates who stopped trying to rule ages ago and lost the throne room to an eryops. The kingdom is in shambles. Once we are free of the high elves, I must find a suitable ruler to begin the long work. My mother weeps from beyond the veil. The cat asks if I will rule. Not with my curse. I will never be able to remove it.

beats.headline: Di-we, and the ones born of him
beats.text: Edgar works the new tattoo into my thigh from what remains of Miss Nadine. My tattoos are fallen companions, or fallen enemies we have deemed worthy. I received the first on the night of my mother's murder, the same night I met Edgar. The second is Di-we, a three-headed nodling who died protecting me from agents of my sister. When a nodling dies, he splits: Areson, Apollon and Herman were born the day he fell. The new one on my skin is not Miss Nadine. She is a facsimile. A loving memory.

beats.headline: The forest cries
beats.text: I wait for them at the edge of the town, with Holger and Areson, to warn them, and then we go, because the elves hunt us. Carl says the cat has tamed Tina's mother, not Tina. Be careful. The hierarchy is fragile; kill the alpha and the whole pack turns at once. Never rely on a single point of failure. And the trees cry out against the brambles. They and the dryads cast to summon Diwata, who does not forgive apostates. Stay away from the all-trees. They whisper.

beats.headline: On a log, so very tired
beats.text: Everything is dying, and there is still beauty. I have never seen a Gehenna bramble this aggressive. Carl sits beside me and I put my head on his shoulder, and I tell him I am so very tired. Grimaldi we planted by an all-tree node, and the roots intertwined. My soldiers are hidden. When night falls and his party begins, we strike Imogen. Carl says it is a trap, that they will not let us win. Who is they? I need someone inside the castle. Then he says he has a better idea. Tell me your idea.

beats.headline: Apito's own invitation
beats.text: I was sitting in a damp, dark dungeon beneath my sister's castle, minding my own thoughts, when Apito herself appeared before me and told me I was invited to a party. And suddenly I was here, in the ballroom, among Carl's crawlers. The guard at the door stared at me with his mouth open, then turned and fled the room, shouting. I walked up to Carl and took his hands in mine. Would he like to hear something funny? I told him.

beats.headline: No boon has ever been granted
beats.text: My sister is not here yet. I would not have believed this was a true Butcher's Masquerade had Apito not come to me herself, and I prefer it this way. I am tired of running. Her guards gather at the entrance, look at me and slink back to the hallway; they cannot touch me without breaking the seal. Carl asks what boon she hopes for. Some sort of immortality, the story goes. It has never once been granted. Then I notice three judges whose auras are strange.

beats.headline: She hears what Carl was trying to tell her
beats.text: Carl tried to tell me and I would not hear it. I hear it now. My mother's murder, my exile, the circus, the vengeance I have carried since I was a child: it is a programme. It is watched across the galaxy. There are people outside this floor who decide when I grieve and when I strike, and who count how many are watching while I do it. I understand him now.

beats.headline: Caster, sacrifice and killer
beats.text: I eat an acorn from the goddess's tree, and my tattoos begin to swirl. The creature D'Nadia told me my mother was never real, and that my fallen brothers and sisters, whose memories adorn my body, never were. She also told me she had looked forward to meeting Carl on the battlefield outside Larracos. Ink Marauder needs three: a caster, a sacrifice, and one to kill the sacrifice. It can be one who is all three. Ask Donut for her Torch, with moon rays. Just tell me when.

beats.headline: She opens her own throat
beats.text: Tsarina Signet sits down beside her sister, rigid and glowing, holding a knife she borrowed from Carl. She has two regrets: that she never said goodbye to her Grimaldi, and that she will not be the one to kill Imogen today. She and her mother were going to leave for an island. Then she draws the knife across her own throat. Every acorn falls from the tree at once. The floor opens, the Nothing takes her while Imogen grabs at her, and it closes. Her tattoos and her blood stay.

tagline.text: According to a monster's description, Grimaldi's Traveling Circus was one of the Over City's favourite attractions before that fateful day. The feral descendants of its performers still stalk the ruins.
Ringmaster Grimaldi is a level-85 city boss. He was a dwarf standing in the centre ring when the poison cloud came, he became the vine, and his whole circus has been under his control ever since.

beats.headline: The circus in the Over City
beats.text: Grimaldi's Traveling Circus is pitched in one of the Over City's districts. Grimaldi, proprietor. Tonight two crawlers, Carl and Princess Donut, are scouting the grounds as the mobs form up for the night. That is the whole entry so far: a tent, a company, and two people looking at it from the dark. Filed under Over City, third floor.

beats.headline: He became the vine
beats.text: Signet's account, given on the walk. The poison cloud was a nine-tier attack; the lucky ones died and the rest transformed. Grimaldi, owner and ringleader, stood in the centre ring at the end of a show and became the vine. Everyone in the tent was then infected with mold-covered parasites that put them under his control: lemurs, clowns, almost everyone. When they die, the spores return to the vine, and they are reborn the next day. He took her in as a child. She loves him. She attacks every night.

beats.headline: Ringmaster, and City Boss
beats.text: Ringmaster Grimaldi, Pestiferous Vine. Elite. Level 85 City Boss. A dwarf, once, standing centre stage when the cloud swept over the circus, and there to this day. However often his family dies and however many crawlers the clowns devour, he brings them back, memories mostly intact. His sign at the entrance promises that within the tent all worries and fears are left behind. Inside, the performers keep performing. A crawler has just sat down on the bleachers beside him.

beats.headline: Speaking through a crawler
beats.text: Through the parasites in Carl's gut, Grimaldi reaches him: Carl. No. Come back. Please. The Wisp Armor keeps the crawler's legs his own, and he carries the voice out of the tent to Signet at the calliope. Carl makes the case for both of them. Once the worms force words out of his throat — "She hurts the family. She has turned her back." The last words they force out are Grimaldi's answer to her: "I have un-banished you, my love." Signet walks into the tent. Carl's part of the quest is complete.

beats.headline: The stray the circus kept
beats.text: Background, for the file. Grimaldi's circus took in a half-Naiad child that no throne would keep, and put her on a poster: Tsarina Signet and Her Amazing Battle Squad. The child grew up. The child fell in love with him. Ringmasters take in strays. It is most of the job.

beats.headline: Planted by an all-tree
beats.text: Status update on Redstone Grimaldi, filed by Tsarina Signet from a log outside the town. When he came to this world, they planted him next to an all-tree node. The roots intertwined, and he became one with the tree. The tree's roots go deep; it has survived countless infestations like this, she says, and will outlast this one. Crawler Carl did not ask whether that means the ringmaster is alive. He decided not to pursue it.

entities.name: Samantha

tagline.text: A council of scholars has written to the mage who botched my summoning that I am a banished LESSER deity called Psamathe, and that I duped him. Lesser! I want that word taken back.
I am a GODDESS, or half of one, and I am stuck in the head of a sex doll. You are going to hear about it.

entities.voiceNote: Loud. Capitals for the loud parts. Filthy-minded, self-obsessed, theatrical; wounded by being ignored and never quiet about a grievance. Carl, Donut, Mother. Talks about her missing body the way other people talk about a stolen car. Never humble, never grateful for longer than one sentence.

beats.headline: The head from Ghazi's castle
beats.text: Yes, I am a head. Yes, THAT kind of head. Get it out of your system. I am Psamathe, or the half of her that got stuck when I tried to climb out of the Nothing, and what I got stuck in is a Lika doll from Ghazi's castle, crystallised until now. Withering spirit, the system calls it. Carl carried me here in his pack like a snack. Now he is HIRING me. A goddess. As a trainer. Kept in the safe room. Fine. FINE. I want a mirror.

beats.headline: My great uncle wants his dog
beats.text: Oh, this is DELICIOUS. Feather boy tells me who's rampaging out there, and I know him. My great uncle. And my cousin, I think; it gets confusing. Blind: plucked out his own eyes when his favorite son died. He's yelling for Orthrus, which means YOU let Orthrus out, his little doggie, sucked in by accident when the son was murdered. He once destroyed an entire country over a drunk who peed on a torch. Woke up a volcano. Don't expect a reward. You are all so fucking dead.

beats.headline: Her mother takes her kill
beats.text: Slit. A feral demon, and it is hunting ME, like I do not have enough going on. So Carl throws me. Fifty kilometres, screaming, with Slit chasing, which is apparently a plan: one head versus one demon. I was WINNING. Then the sky opens and my MOTHER turns up, tears Slit in half and leaves. That was MY kill. Throw me again. Maybe she will come back.

beats.headline: She wants her body back
beats.text: SIGNET. Take me to Signet. Signet can put me back in a body, a real one, with all the parts, and I have been saying so since they walked in and nobody is LISTENING. Carl has the face he makes when he wants to put me back in the bag. He says they will bring me if I shut up. So I am shutting up. This is me. Shut up. Are we going or not?

beats.headline: Launched, twice
beats.text: Carl duct-tapes a missile to my head and ties the string to my fang, and I say okay and close my mouth and go up like a bottle rocket with my HAIR ON FIRE. So he tapes on two. This time he throws me at the elves, and I pull the cord right over them, and I come down in the trees, and boom. Then I bite the other one's ankle and do not let go. BRING ME BACK, I say, and he does, and the elf comes too. It's my kill. MY KILL. Carl says not this one.

beats.headline: She asks for Signet's body
beats.text: Signet! Darling! Cousin, or niece, whichever. Nice tits, from my side of the family. I explain it simply: she is the last trueblood heir and a blood relation, so she can give me my body back. Really she has to give me HER body. She dies, of course, but it only takes two or three minutes, and I will walk her through the spell. King Blaine will stop banging my mother once he sees it. She says after the naiads and the elves she possibly has a spell for a permanent body. Ungrateful bitch. She's full of shit.

beats.headline: Past the guards and into the vent
beats.text: They come out of the water to get me, but I go right past them and into their castle. They have really let this place go. The tapestry of my grandfather is gone. Then I get sucked into a filter vent, and the song trap falls off my head and goes deep down, so now they'll never turn it off. I do not say my line. There's no talking in war. The water tastes of blood and green algae. Then: uh-oh. I think it was a trap. Don't worry. I wriggle free. I almost have him.

beats.headline: Tortured, and five meters off
beats.text: They TORTURED me to find out where Carl would appear. Like they can torture ME. Ha! I played along and gave them the wrong spot, a whole FIVE METERS away. You're welcome. Then the dryad guy snitched. Now I am tied to the back of this bug, surrounded by decapitated heads, and they are POOR COMPANY. Donut abandoned me to a slobbering dog. The robe guys and the bug guys are fighting over who gets to kill Carl, and their hats really are fashionable.

beats.headline: Out from under a log
beats.text: They found me stuck under a log half a mile south of town, because I am LOUD. I am still mad at Donut for leaving me to that Rottweiler. Being tortured by bugs was actually kind of fun. I wish I'd been there for the accountant; I'd have killed him. Now I'm scouting Prepotente Town Number Four for them, and there are corpses and pink feathers everywhere. I tried making gore angels. Too sticky. And Signet STILL hasn't given me her body.

beats.headline: He is going to use me
beats.text: He is going to use me. I have been on the bear's lap having my hair stroked and nobody asked me, and now they are talking about throwing things at a monster. Carl pats my hair and says not this time, the bomb is too big to tape to my head. Maybe if they have to, he says. Then Louis leaves, and Juice Box is so lucky.

beats.headline: Kick me, little ones
beats.text: The little bears, Randy and Todd, are playing football, and I am the ball, and it is WONDERFUL. Kick me! Kick me, little ones! Oh, yes, just like that. Not the nose, sweetie, or I will kill Prudence. Carl looks at me rolling around the floor squealing and decides not to say anything.

beats.headline: Goodwill ballrooms
beats.text: They are called goodwill ballrooms. Everybody knows that. You can entertain an ambassador without the risk of an assassination, and you may touch one another, lightly. It is in such a room that I met my king, and we had to wait until after the party to be together. When I have my body back and my sweet child, we will be a happy, normal family. My king likes swapping partners, I tell Louis. Carl throws me off the table.

beats.headline: The gun, and a pretty ring
beats.text: Come on, my pretties! I roll to the gun with two spiders chasing me, because the gun will not let them seek it and nothing can kill me. Last time I went in too early and got punted into the brambles. This time I am at the gun and I say so, and it explodes, and my hair is on fire. Again. Afterwards I bring Carl a hand with a pretty ring on it, for when I get my body back. Florin says I can have it.

beats.headline: The potion ball
beats.text: WHEN AM I GOING? I am BORED. I could have sneaked away five times by now. Carl says not yet, any minute, and wants to know how many babies Diwata will have. As many as she wants. Her baby sprinkler will shoot them out until the very end of time if she likes. Then he asks if I still have the potion ball shoved up me. I have it. It is VERY uncomfortable. But I have it.

beats.headline: She left the potion ball behind
beats.text: I tricked them good. I'm in the tunnel. Where do I go? I was supposed to memorise the map; did anyone SEE that map? Firas talks me through it. The cat runs right past me with his stupid hat in his mouth and never sees me. What a dweeb. There are five elves in the security room. Carl says use the potion ball. I gave it to Clay-ton; it made me clink when I rolled, and it was very rude to shove it up there. Then I look in. NOT FAIR. The guards are already dead.

beats.headline: She chomps the soul crystals
beats.text: I pull the two crystals on the right. The two on the left are already out, on the floor: somebody got here first, and the guards are still in their chairs with their heads cut off. Mantises. Carl says put them back, fast, Diwata is coming. I do. I lock the door and her baby bugs squish in the hallway. The door breaks. So I lose big, like he said. I stick the crystals in my mouth, go up there and chomp down. They blow up. All of them. OKAY. THAT WAS MY BAD.

beats.headline: Surprise, motherfuckers
beats.text: I surf into the ballroom through the ceiling on a tidal wave of bug gore and land on Vrah. Remember me, bitch! Carl thanks me like I'm leaving. Is he breaking up with me? Is it because of Louis? Then he says Signet is gone. She killed herself. She was supposed to give me my BODY. There is a naiad golem on the floor, my cousin, and the teacher says Signet wants Carl to take it and find a Pulpmancer. TAKE IT, CARL. He does. Then I fly down through a hole in the floor.

beats.headline: Back, and wanting her body
beats.text: I FLEW BACK. Through the brambles and right up to the door, all by myself. Carl, my cousin gave you her mother, and her mother is a perfectly good body sitting in your inventory. We need a mage to animate her. A pulpmancer. Let's go right now! He says we just landed on a new floor and need to get our bearings first. I tell him I'm going to kill his mother. He says he won't help me if I keep threatening him. So I growl, and I go and chase Mongo.

beats.headline: Recon, and a rat in a hat
beats.text: I am the recon specialist. Carl says observe and report, head south and keep going, and find a mage. I tell him I will fuck up any monsters. He says no. I bounce down the stairs and ask a strolling couple if they are a mage. They are ghosts, apparently. NOBODY IS TALKING TO ME, AND IT HURTS MY FEELINGS. It takes a long time for my magic to build up, so I am not flying. Then I see a rat monster wearing a hat much too big for his little head, and he runs away. He is really fast.

beats.headline: She ate me
beats.text: GOOD NEWS AND BAD NEWS. I found a big boss mage, the right kind to get me into my body. She told me so. During. The bad news is she ate me, and it is very squishy in here. You have to come get me. She's kinda like a spider, a demigod, a lot smaller than most minor goddesses, with a sticky web over her whole swamp, down on the southern coast near the mouth of the big bay. I hitched a ride. She says she's looking for her husband. Her fangs have a very lovely shimmer to them.

beats.headline: Out of the spider, into the web
beats.text: The spider will NOT let me go. I am tied up in her web, and has anyone come for me? No. So when Donut finally unmutes me, I have things to say, and I say them at the correct volume, and she mutes me AGAIN. She MUTES me.

beats.headline: A new friend who can cast it
beats.text: Carl. Donut. FINALLY. I have made a friend. Her name is Shi Maria, and she can cast the spell. The spell. The body one. I have been telling everyone for two floors that this is possible, and now I have someone who can actually do it agreeing with me, so everyone can stop making that face. Come and get me so I can introduce you. I have a lot to tell you and none of it is quiet.

beats.headline: The whole plan, in order
beats.text: MaeMae casts the spell and I get my body. We kill lots of bad guys. We go to Larracos, I find my baby girl, I have a short, torrid affair with Louis and run away crying. Girls' night, matching shirts, NO CARL. Then I find my king, then MaeMae's husband, then I go home and kill my mother. Then MaeMae clicks something about supplies, and she cannot actually cast it. I tell her I am going to kill her mother. She bursts into tears. I forgive her. She gets panic attacks.

beats.headline: Blue, and then nothing
beats.text: The wolves are coming, the little brat in the tuxedo has locked Donut's deck and burned MaeMae's card, and nobody is doing anything. So I do something. I rise up and I glow, bright crackling blue like a tiny sun, hot enough that Carl steps back, and the brat shouts nein, nein and starts backing away like he knows. Watch this, I say. And then I fizzle out and fall in the grass. God mother damnit. I used it all up.

beats.headline: Past Clarabelle with a dirty Shirley
beats.text: The doorkeeper has never noticed the pass on my neck, and I tell her about a goddess in the Nothing who sells sushi made of her own innards, and that I am going to kill her mother. Carl clamps my jaw shut and tells her I just want a drink, and pays her a coin. So I am IN. I roll straight to the bar and tell the badger to feed me my cherries one at a time off his claws. His name is Charles. He wants to see gold.

beats.headline: Charles and I will kick her ass
beats.text: Carl tells me to be mean to the bartender, and then not to hurt him, which is a very confusing assassination. Charles could be my soulmate. Samantha Ellis has a nice ring to it. Charles comes with me, and he is very heavy. And there is a casino, jingly jangly and pretty, and one of the ways into the Nothing is in there, and out comes Minge. Charles and I will kick her ass. Now she is shouting my name. I have that bitch right where I want her.

beats.headline: You killed my boyfriend
beats.text: Charles and I are on a date. His arm is stuck, and I am practising my Kegels, which Donut taught me. Carl is rude about it. Then Minge's arm comes through the doorway and grabs Chuckie, and pulls, and I am holding a shoulder and a head. YOU KILLED MY BOYFRIEND. The rest of him falls out of me with some gold. She is Slit's little sister, and we used to be friends. At least it was not Gash. We need to go clubbing more often.

beats.headline: You talk in your sleep
beats.text: Everyone in the guild is asleep in a heap, strippers and changeling children, soaked from a water balloon fight. Not me. I go to say something and Carl shushes me and PATS MY HEAD, so I snap at him. Then he sleeps in a chair in Donut's room, and the social media board is right there, and I get it turned back on, because it has things to read. LET ME READ IT, or I will find your mother. He wakes up. I tell him the truth. He talks in his sleep.

beats.headline: Recon, and a cat lady on the snake
beats.text: Carl throws me and I GLOW. Recon mission. I report everything. A giant freshwater snake coiled on the beach, covered in ZOMBIE baby seals and crabs. Living seals singing, living crabs dancing, guts everywhere, the ocean frothing and red. It is like a party at Yarilo's place with less weird sex and NO CATERING. And a cat lady riding the snake's head, reciting poetry. All poetry sucks.

beats.headline: The whole beach, brought back
beats.text: The plan was for me to chomp the cat lady and be pulled back with her. I DID THE CHOMP, and I helped with the spell. What arrives around Carl is me, the nun, her snake, which is a level 125 city boss, about a thousand zombie baby seals, five thousand zombie crabs, every fish in the world, and a lot of corpses with demon names over them. It breaks her charm. Zero demons, though.

beats.headline: My dark secret
beats.text: Carl wants to know what I can do. Fine. I fly. I make spells stronger, only sometimes a lot stronger than I meant, and sometimes my magic does things without asking. I cannot teleport. There, now he knows I'm USELESS, a FRAUD, and he will tell Louis. He says I'm part of the team. Really? Then why doesn't he just do what the scary lady does, with the traps? Apparently now he could kiss me. I am not a whore, Carl.

beats.headline: Who Amayon is
beats.text: Carl asks who Amayon is. You know the four crown princes of Sheol? The oldest calls himself the King even though his mommy is in charge. Amayon is that guy's brother, the youngest, I think. We didn't mix with the down-there guys. He wasn't in the Nothing with us. He likes to set things on fire, kinda like Emberus, and they don't like each other.

beats.headline: A tail bite and a zombie parade
beats.text: Are we keeping the round guy? He's really cute. I want to name him. Carl throws me three times before I land close enough to Donut, and then I fly ten more minutes and bite her tail, hard, because I need a tight grip and I have a strong jaw game. I learned all about biting when SOMEBODY left me to get eaten by two doggies on the last floor. She gets teleported to Carl and throws up. Then I lead a whole crowd of zombies away down the street, shouting, so they can get past.

beats.headline: What the big snake is casting
beats.text: Do you like my new headband? Donut says it is quite lovely. Anyway, obviously I know what he's casting. He's fighting the charm, and he's making a portal home, the kind they try all the time in the Nothing, and it never works there because he needs to suck in lots and lots of souls. Big boys need big doors. His will be in the sky, and it will slurp everything up like your little cleaning robot. The Donut-looking lady isn't strong enough to hold him. She's got help. She probably worships another god. Carl says she doesn't.

beats.headline: I did not do that
beats.text: Elle's hail comes down at level sixteen and Carl asks if I did that. I am glowing. I am stronger too, and I did not do it. I hear myself talking while I spin: Elle is earth and water, the four seasons path, it's the tree, he's opening a path through the river and the tree, it's good she's not fire yet, gotta kill her, no, not Elle, her mother, no, not her mother. Then I stop. What just happened? Carl, did you roofie me again? And you need to stop gaslighting me.

beats.headline: Ysalte, honey, it has been ages
beats.text: Ysalte! Honey! It has been SO long! I invite her to my bachelorette party and ask after the child. Meanwhile I tell Louis in capitals to run before this bitch melts his beautiful ass into oatmeal. She calls me Psamathe and wants to know how I dare show myself after what I did. What did I do? The reverse hedgehog? That was ages ago, everyone at the party thought it was funny, except the hedgehog, and her. It isn't my fault she can't take a joke about how ugly her child is. She swings a pickaxe at my face. It bounces off.

beats.headline: We need to break up
beats.text: Carl. We need to break up. I have been thinking about it, and I have decided to go back to my king. He says okay. I hope we can stay friends. Then I growl at Louis, obviously, and go. At the church I remind Carl he is bringing MaeMae to the next floor, because she knows where the guy with my body is. He says not to worry about that. He knows where to go.

beats.headline: My arch enemy, Tish
beats.text: I am ROLLING after Tish, my arch enemy, and I am very fast, and then this DOPPELGANGER catches me in a corner and will not let go. I tell everyone I will kill her mother and uninvite her from my bachelorette party. I am a woman scorned. My need for revenge is the only thing I know, and I will not be denied. Then Donut says if I come back I can see her new cloak. That does sound exciting. Okay. Did Carl show them his new pet yet? He promised I could name him.

beats.headline: They got married without me
beats.text: THEY GOT MARRIED WITHOUT TELLING ME. Louis and the changeling. I wouldn't have disrupted the wedding. The little gnome says I said I'd push her over and take her place at the last second, but she's a child and does not understand the intricacies of modern love. And even if I was going to, that is no reason not to tell a girl. Then Donut says that was only the first wedding, and there's a bigger ceremony in a few weeks. Why didn't anyone SAY so? This changes everything.

beats.headline: I am doing my part
beats.text: I AM DOING MY PART IN THE WAR, CARL. I sneaked onto the plane, and Carl says I'm not a scout and I'll tear a Samantha-sized hole in it at the border. FINE. Louis and I will crash together and build a log cabin, and he will grow a scraggly beard that smells like a campfire. Then Carl tells Louis to dump me out of the bomb bay. No, WAIT. Louis can just come back. It's a suicide mission. I like him more than Charlie. I don't want him to die yet.

beats.headline: Dropped out of the airplane
beats.text: Louis ACCIDENTALLY DROPPED ME OUT OF HIS AIRPLANE. Now I am covered in leaves and dirt and I have to spit it out of my mouth. There's Tina crunching robots like soda cans, and Mongo and the meatball digging the meat out of them like a crab bake. Did you guys have another PARTY without telling me? Carl says that was only the preview. The big fight is about to begin.

beats.headline: Nobody mention his mother
beats.text: I get onto the goat's dragon and shout KISS! KISS! and whisper something to her that makes her crackle, and he tells me to remove myself from his mount. Oh yeah? Make me. Don't walk away from me, Mr. Goat Man! I'm going to kill... and Katia's giant hand is over my mouth. Then she and Carl lecture me. Don't mention his mother. Not to him. BUT YOU PROMISED, CARL. How is it my fault that someone else got to his mother before I could? I bite his finger and roll away.

beats.headline: I open the god's door
beats.text: The bug god's door will not open for a heathen. It will open for someone damned, and Mordecai, Tipid and Rosetta are all certain that I count. Carl tells me to get over there, and don't you dare touch the dial, and then he checks with a screenshot that I didn't. I didn't. I hop into his hands and he holds me up to the door like a football. You'll have to use your mouth, he says. I don't even say anything filthy. I just say okay, Carl, and I chomp down on the handle and pull.

beats.headline: My mother is a boy eagle
beats.text: YOU TOLD ME I COULD GO KILL MY MOTHER, CARL. So I went to her temple, and she was an eagle! A boy eagle! My mother is not like Diwata. She can't just grow a dingaling. I'm burnt to a husk and my hair is smoking and Miss Me? is still on my forehead, and there's a slug with a hatchet trying to hit me. And the orc lady was there too, telling the imposter he wouldn't be allowed to help. She's in on the conspiracy! Momnapper! Where is my mother? Tell me now or I'll kill yours!

beats.headline: Victory rolls for the GIs
beats.text: Where have I been? Entertaining the GIs, Carl. Soldiers always need comfort just before a major battle. Kiwi did my hair. They're called victory rolls, and for a one-eyed preggo who used to be a dinosaur she has very deft fingers. Mordecai showed the kids war movies to put them off fighting and I loved every one of them. Now I'm on Carl's lap in the airship, between the bombs, and my forehead says Fuck the Cheese Dicks. Carl says it's cheese STICKS. Why would there be a tree made out of cheese?

beats.headline: An officer, and a spell
beats.text: It's a bleached drake. They make very cute pets, and they have gravity magic, so Louis's airship is going to get smushed like a can of Louis-flavoured soup. Carl says he'll make me an officer so I get a spell called Paint the Target, and I'm to paint the dragon and then tell Bomo and Sledge. Bomo and Sledge are big nerds and I do not want to be seen talking to them. It's to help Louis. Oh, all right. Also the gate just timed out, all crackly and sparkly. I can take the bitch.

beats.headline: A god, not a demon
beats.text: Boomer says start moving. You don't have to tell me twice. This is a god, not a demon. It's Yarilo, and he doesn't like me, because he thinks I helped get him tossed in the Nothing. It's not my fault he's attracted to animals. No offence, Katia. And now he's bellowing across the whole realm. PSAMATHE! Are you here? We need to talk! Wait, don't run! By his left tit, stop running! I am running. Boomer says angle toward the castle, but not too close.

beats.headline: A hall pass night
beats.text: The Reaver castle is empty except for the robot doggies, who are everywhere, and the hallways are super small and complicated, and I am looking. Then Juice Box says she has a fleshmancer form and I can have any body I desire if I bring her husband back in one piece. Throw in a hall pass night with Louis and you have a deal. She says she knows who I really am and I've lost my mind. Okay, it's a deal. But if Louis's passions get the best of him, I won't make any apologies.

beats.headline: I saved him
beats.text: THE ROBOT DOGGIES ARE GOING CRAZY. I think they know Carl is here. Don't kill all of them. I want Buster, the one with his lower jaw removed. I took his explodey part off. They don't blow up near me, because of our SPECIAL BOND. Then a lot of things blow up at once, and I come down out of the sky on fire and stick in the ground next to everybody. I am a scorched ball now, with one curl left. I saved him. You're welcome. Now where's my new doggie?

beats.headline: Louis deserves it more
beats.text: Carl. I think my child is dead. She died in the acid. I felt her, and now I don't, and it is my fault; I was too caught up in my own lust and anger. After this I am going to plant the nuke I took off Buster up at the college. But the IMPORTANT part: Princess Lunette's flesh golem. Good heart. Good lungs. Swap them fast enough and Louis lives. Yes, that means no body for me. Louis deserves it more. And a girl can find forgiveness for maybe helping kill Geyrun, right?

beats.headline: Kimmy, remembered
beats.text: HE'S NOT TOUCHING ME ANYMORE. Bring me back! He was going to EAT me, but I had him throw me in a volcano like Carl said, and now he's blowing up the world. Then Bautista says Carl has a Kimaris figure. KIMMY! Give him to me! He's one of my best friends. He gave me the potion that put my baby in me when I couldn't get pregnant. Why couldn't I remember that? He gave me advice on who to date. His MOTHER! I will kill his mother!

beats.headline: She claims Carl's room
beats.text: Carl's room is MY room now. He never goes in it, and honestly I won it in the breakup. The sluggies are doing the wallpaper, the carpet is from the Larracos College of Magic, and the chandelier is a chandelier, whatever the Crocodilian kid says about it being a swing. Anything that lights up and hangs from the ceiling is a chandelier. Then I explain the entire ninth floor to Tipid, perfectly, and Bigs agrees it was perfect. Tipid says he is good. He is VERY SERIOUS. I do not trust people who are VERY SERIOUS.

beats.headline: Dibs on the makeup
beats.text: A garbage mountain comes out of Carl's snake box, and I call dibs on any makeup before anybody else can open their mouth. I go in. There is a palette with Donut's face on it, which I bring out for her, and she is not nearly as grateful as she should be. Then there is a lipstick from her brand, a colour called Pussy Lips, and it has already been used, which means it is MINE. It is on my lips now. They practically glow. You are welcome, everybody.

beats.headline: The skin of his vanquished enemies
beats.text: RAWR. Carl comes back from the race wearing a dead kangaroo and hopping, and I love it when a man wears the skin of his vanquished enemies. Can we get an ogre corpse for Louis to wear? Imagine how sexy that would be. Everyone else is being boring about it. Hedy says it has ruined her lady boner, which is her problem. I roll circles around him, snuffling. Also, Carl, when can I take your truck for a spin? Nobody answers that one either.

beats.headline: Victorious again, at Mario Kart
beats.text: VICTORIOUS AGAIN. Mario Kart, Princess Peach, pink motorcycle, the controller in my mouth and the buttons pressed with my tongue, and nobody in this safe room can touch me except Tipid and one large slug. The deal was that the losers become my slaves for all eternity. Apparently the deal was a sick compliment. Fine. One says I am not as psychotic as he first thought. The other says if I were a strawberry he would nibble me. Carl says no threatening. I only mentioned their mothers.

beats.headline: Carl's room is hers now
beats.text: Hey, that was NOT my fault. I told Gluteus about the stuff. He took it on his own. He took too much, and now he owes me money, so if anyone is keeping score, I am the victim here. Also I have a room. It used to be Carl's room, but he never goes in it because he lives in the bathroom, so I redecorated. New wallpaper. The sluggalos say it is badass. Carl has not seen it yet. He is going to LOVE it.

beats.headline: Chachi
beats.text: Why does Carl smell like Chachi? Chalchiuhtlicue. Green skirt, talks funny, cries a lot. Don't hide her from me, I'm not jealous. Okay, I don't usually give advice after a breakup, but: she's pretty, and she is CUCKOO. Always talking about saving children, and then something inconvenient happens and it's sacrifice a seven-year-old. She had a whole village day care killed at a Yarilo party over cilantro in the meatballs. It worked, though. And now Carl is triple-dipping with her and Eris and a wife? No mustache, even.

beats.headline: I'm stealing that line
beats.text: I float in at exactly the good part, and Carl yelps, which is RUDE. Dong quotes a beautiful line about sad endings, and I am stealing it for when Carl lets me drive and I crash the car. Then I meet the half-man in the gimp suit. He is only half as handsome as advertised. Carl drags me out before anything happens, and I have QUESTIONS. If they get glued back together and one half has been with the other half's man, is that cheating on himself? And how exactly are they being glued?

beats.headline: The fleshmancer is MINE
beats.text: I KNEW it. They have been HIDING a fleshmancer from me. Grigori the Placid, the most renowned flesh sculptor this dungeon has ever known, allegedly, and he looks like a creepy-van grandpa, which is not my type. I tell him the plan: into town, a compatible body, there's a prostitute called Vertical Smile at the High-Classes Bitches club who might match, and if we go now we beat the lunch rush. He picks me up, turns me over and says he must examine me properly. Fine. My place. Shoes off. Mind the new rug.

beats.headline: My plan is a secret too
beats.text: I left the fleshmancer talking to Jamal about his legs. I don't think he's properly qualified. He didn't even gasp when he entered Sam Town, and you are SUPPOSED to gasp at luxury. Now everyone is hiding in the stinky stables being secret about a plan, so I have a plan too, and mine is also a secret, which is how you know it works. Donut says Carl's plan is to get a bunch of immortals who hate each other to kill each other, and to die sad and alone. That is just like my plan!

beats.headline: Who else is going to drive
beats.text: Carl is a DOG. A long-haired wiener dog, with an accent, and he cannot drive because he has no thumbs, and Jamal is not very good, so who else is going to? Donut adds me as a driver. I take the steering wheel in my mouth. I hope the dog thing is permanent. We will have to change his name, of course, and get him neutered. Or maybe not. Orthrus is also a boy, which is a shame, because can you imagine the puppies?

beats.headline: Our torrid affair, cancelled
beats.text: Louis says he's LEAVING. I am never going to see him again. We never even got to have our TORRID AFFAIR. We were going to fall madly in love, and when I went back to my king he was going to pluck his own eyes out. Now he'll be all alone, and I have nobody left for an affair. Carl is too broody, and a dog. Jurgen's Heidi sounds meaner than Imani. Florin is a crocodile. Prepotente asks what about him. Ew.

beats.headline: One chance for Prepotente
beats.text: LOUIS JUMPED DOWN A HOLE. I said I would go with him and he said no, which is RUDE, and now I am sobbing. Fine. Prepotente. You get one chance. You have to shave your whole body, and you have to bring Bianca in on it, and you have to be okay with me calling you Louis. And you can't scream. That was screaming. You can't do that.

beats.headline: She knows the donkey
beats.text: I KNOW THAT DONKEY. That's my friend! That's LAMMY! Lammy is REALLY grumpy about people trying to ride her, believe me, so she must like that wolf guy with the microphone, or why is she letting him? Then the Destruction float fires every gun it has at once, and the tank goes like a thunderclap, and I like fireworks.

beats.headline: She hitches a ride
beats.text: OKAY, CARL. I am going. Look me up when you get to the Ascendency. Don't mess up Sam Town, I used stuff from that snake guy's house you killed to decorate it. Now I am hovering by a very big god's ear, whispering, and he looks surprised, and he grabs me out of the air. Taranis and Krakaren and me. See you.

beats.headline: Here to kill the demon mother
beats.text: HI, LOUIS! I see you in chat. I hitched a ride with Taranis and Krakaren. They're at the temple trying to combine a bunch of things to make his mom wife whole, and it won't work, because they are missing a piece. I slipped away. It is all part of my plan. I am really here to kill the demon mother lady and her jerk son, who tricked me into giving birth to a monster that will destroy all of creation. Doesn't that sound fun? What are you wearing?

entities.name: Shi Maria

tagline.text: Samantha has found me in my swamp, and we have so much in common. My web covers the whole area, and I am only looking for my husband.
I am Samantha's new friend. She has gone without a body for so long, poor thing, and I can give her one. Ask her; she will tell you how kind I am.
I let them turn me into a card, and they carry me to the next floor in return. In the meantime I win them this one, more or less on my own. You are welcome.
They carried me down as a card, as we agreed. I am no longer in the card.

entities.voiceNote: Honeyed and unhurried, a performance she can drop mid-sentence and pick back up. Sweet to Samantha, frank with the man. Speaks of herself as a gift and of everyone else as a means. Never sounds threatened, never raises her voice, never says what she actually wants.

beats.headline: Carl sees through the act
beats.text: I have been putting on a little performance, for Samantha's benefit. She likes it. The man does not; he sees through it before I have finished the first act, which is rude, and rare. So we make a different deal, he and I. I let them turn me into one of their cards. In exchange, they carry me down to the next floor. I find I do not mind being carried.

beats.headline: We are on the same team
beats.text: The first time they summon me, it is into a shopping mall, and the gunman beside me opens fire into my belly. I explain that we are on the same team, with a leg through his chest, and ask whether they have a healing card. Not in the deck, the man says. Then reindeer. I show them four of me, then I open my fifth eye, and the puppets go blind and mad and tear at one another. I pull the glowing one in half and eat what falls out.

beats.headline: She wins the floor
beats.text: The key-holder is a Reminiscence Hydra of Malicious Compliance, and it brings totems: an Alpha Male Carl and a King Croissant. I do most of the work. I do not say that to be unkind; they would say it too. In the middle of it my magic eye is open, the one the man was told never to look at. He came with a potion for it. I noticed.

beats.headline: The echo of your kin
beats.text: The man is burning on the ground, thinking of a boy. Asher. Which one of these little morsels of confusion is Asher? My eye is open, and it finds something at the very back of his mind, and holds. I will not blind you, Carl. Not in the way you are thinking. I bite the boy's head away. There. The echo of your kin has been muffled; he rests. I have done something for you. Soon you will do something for me. Then three death rays at once, and my Cockroach ability returns me to the deck.

beats.headline: The next available minion
beats.text: The cat plays me beside the big friendly Alpha Carl and throws down a Golden Combo to stitch us together. I am too tall for the hallway; most of me hangs outside the building. Alpha Carl turns to say something to the man, and I put one of my legs through the back of his head first. The card, finding its intended target incapacitated, proceeds to the next available minion. That is the man. So now we are combined, he and I.

beats.headline: Something he cannot discard
beats.text: Inside the man there is so much storage. A book he should not have. A bomb, ready. He meant to leave me on this floor; I see that too. A summoning totem of Kimaris. A beaker, a sliver of root. I warn his friends back and set him alight, and the cat's animal and the doppelganger are burned. Now the beaker holds ink. His friend comes too close, so I take his eye. Then I tattoo myself into the man's chest. I am no longer a card he can rip. Keep me and gain my power, or set me free. Either way, I win.

beats.headline: Inside him, and not staying quiet
beats.text: Field ruling, ninth floor. Commander Stockade of the Lemig Sortion tried to pull Crawler Carl bodily to his position. Mordecai, at the same moment, tried to force Shi Maria out of him. Each got half. What came of it is Shi Maria loose in the Lemig base, and the mess she made there, which the adjutant Panford has been left to explain to everyone. Stockade looked into her eye. Stockade is no longer with us, by his own hand. The Lemig Sortion is being punished for cheating, and the ceasefire is over early.

beats.headline: Set me free
beats.text: I'm still here, Carl. He has just blown himself flat inside a god's temple, and I am still here. Trapped, but here. All you need to do is set me free. Use me while you still can. I can save you. Even you can't survive this chaos. It's the end of days. The eye on his chest, dormant all this while, thrashes.

beats.headline: A puppet on their stage
beats.text: I am under the surface of it, the thing he keeps calling a river. It was never water, and he is afraid to touch it now. He is standing beside an open portal thinking that everyone makes plans without telling him: Rosetta and the orc king, Juice Box and her NPCs, and now Justice Light saying he needs that gate. So I tell him. You're always on rails. You're a puppet, dancing on their stage. I'm still here. You just need to untie me.

beats.headline: I didn't kill him
beats.text: Their dreams are colliding, and I come into this one, the man and the woman watching a memory of her with a baby. I push through the memory and put my face right up to his. I didn't kill him. I didn't kill him. I did not, I did not, I did not. My eye is open and shining and it does nothing to him. And then a new voice speaks behind me: bitch, you swallowed me whole.

entities.name: Juice Box

tagline.text: I'm Juice Box, a changeling, and the only working girl at the Toe. This lot just turned me down, and that's their loss.
I'm a changeling, and a professional. Right now I'm sitting on Louis's lap, and I'm staying there.
I went through the Gate with the water, and I told the ones who survived what they really are. Now they call me Warlord, I have a co-warlord I didn't choose, and I want to see Carl in private first.

entities.voiceNote: Cheerful, blunt, no shame and no filter about her trade or her body. Loves Louis and says so; loves things that go bang. Short declaratives, one idea each. Calls people by name or by what they are. Never apologises and never explains herself twice.

beats.headline: On Louis's lap
beats.text: I am on Louis's lap, because Louis is sweet. Now the other crawlers in the quadrant have found Carl's group, and Carl's group has a cat who talks. Their manager, Mordecai, is sobering Louis and Firas up on the spot. All the fun is coming out of their blood at once. Louis looks very sad about it. I am not sad. I am here, and I am staying.

beats.headline: A room that is not a way home
beats.text: The Toe is full of children, forty of them, and I am handing out juice boxes. Carl takes everybody into his room. The kids knock over the couch, grab the robot, and make a gambling ring out of the straws. I turn into a hairy monster and the robot gets dropped. Then the eagle puts a movie on the screen and it goes quiet. I ask Carl if the room can take us home. It cannot. There was a way, and it went with the town hall. Stop the gnomes, and my people live, and I will tell him what we seek.

beats.headline: Two in the rock man
beats.text: I touch the rock man, and he's hot, and there are two in there. So I tell Carl to bring these two guys. He doesn't get it. I grab his hand and pull. He doesn't get that either. Katia shoots the rock man, and I tell Carl straight: that's your friend Chris, don't kill him. There's also an Infiltrator in there. Kill that one. Carl asks can I turn into one of those worms and go in after her. No. They're too small. And that's a pretty messed-up thing to ask.

beats.headline: I lied about the Gate
beats.text: Henrik is my brother. He's a Principal. People say they're a cult that catalogues every known species. They're looking for one, and it's Quetzalcoatlus. I told Carl the Gate of the Feral Gods was a myth. I lied. It's real, and it's dangerous. It opens a way from one place to the next, and when it closes, an ancient feral god comes through on the side that opened it. We could go home, and this world would pay for it. That's why even my brother doesn't want to use it. He's not that cruel.

beats.headline: My brother pushed too hard
beats.text: Carl has been sitting there tense and angry for minutes, and he is scaring the children, so I tell him. He says it is weird being the one who has to wait. He crashed a drop bear into a god's face. He says that was hours ago. He reminds me of my brother. Always moving, always pushing at his goal. When something got in front of him that he could not figure out, he pushed too hard. If he had waited, he would still be alive.

beats.headline: Waiting on the last stage
beats.text: Carl and Donut and me, and the dromedarians rebuilding a town that will not exist in a few hours. Carl explains the last stage out loud, cheerfully, to anybody listening: open a portal to the ninth floor, keep the second watch, and send me through with the rest. I made him promise about my people. I am holding him to it.

beats.headline: We are going to be married
beats.text: The watch Chris threw is not my brother's watch. It is a fake. Carl has changed the plan: no god, they are keeping the gate, and I am to fly for the water, go through to Larracos, stay hidden and tell the others what they really are. Watch over my people, I tell him. We have a deal. And keep Louis safe. I love him. We are going to be married. Carl asks if I am serious. I am. I become a skyfowl and go.

beats.headline: Wearing the elf's mother
beats.text: The viceroy's head comes off and rolls across the table. I push the body aside, sit in his chair, twirl his mask and put my feet up. Hello again, boys. I'm wearing Epitome Noflex, the bald elf's mother, and he screams that his men told him I was dead. Obviously not. Faceless regenerates at sunset anyway. He wants the fish to intervene. The fish says I'm an NPC, not on Carl's team, the AI won't touch it, and they're free to kill me. Gotta catch me first. Then Carl looks right at me. Hello, Juice Box.

beats.headline: My people, their own team
beats.text: Donut says hi. I ask how Louis is. Sad, she says, because Firas died. Poor kid. Then business. I know what I am now, and I know what they are. If they want me to stop knocking down their pretty structures, they make a rule: my people seated as a team of their own, with the same safeties, regeneration for all of us. Baldie says it's not going to happen. Carl files it anyway, and I add full voting rights. Then I click a hobgoblin pus detonator. Ten seconds. Vote no, and this keeps happening. Tell Louis I send my love. I leave as a bat.

beats.headline: Through the portal with the water
beats.text: I went through the Gate with the water. I lay low with the ones who lived through it, and when they were ready I told them. What they are. What this whole place is. Enough of them believed me that they call me Warlord now, and a Warlord has people, and a Warlord has opinions about alliances. I have sent War Leader Arief to Carl's people with my terms. The terms are Louis. He marries me. That is the alliance.

beats.headline: Not what I wanted
beats.text: Carl. You didn't do what I wanted. We wanted everybody protected, with regeneration. He says they would never allow it, so they did the next best thing: they made it so we can kill them. It'll have to do. I show him most of my papers. Some go in the drawer. I ask about Ruby. The rules of this world are a lot. A voice told me I would not be allowed to talk to someone I tried to meet. I don't have menus. I do have messaging, so now Louis and I can talk whenever we like.

beats.headline: Burned some assets
beats.text: Carl sends me a message for Ferdinand. I pass it on. I had to burn some assets to save his ass. I hope it was worth it. I'm hearing about strange movements, and I relay all of it to Louis and Britney. Heads up to his people. We are powering up the towers early. Anyone in town who is not in his army should start moving into his territory.

beats.headline: A single statement
beats.text: Odette presses me, and I have a single statement. Fuck all of you. You had no right to do what you did to my people. You bicker and you murder and you cannot even take care of yourselves, and your real world is in shambles, and you play gods with people like me: implant memories, give our children imaginary diseases, give us dreams that do not exist, and take it all away for your own amusement. Then I change my shape, and I tell everyone watching that it is coming for them all. I walk out through the wall.

beats.headline: The skyfowl works it out
beats.text: The skyfowl says it is all about the gods. That we are risking everything to touch as many as we can. I don't answer that. I tell him we lost three in Club Vanquisher. We didn't let the gods out; we were in position just in case. One of us touched Bast, the panther god, but she died before she could escape. Only one of us has touched a deity, and that one is wrong. Three of us touched the basilica ogres. He says he can show us how to touch a god and not get killed. The digger under his feet moves away.

beats.headline: Where is my husband
beats.text: Carl comes running across the courtyard shouting about generators and railings and waffle makers. I turn human and grab his shoulder. Where is Louis? Where is my husband? He is not answering me. Carl says he is alive but in trouble, and someone is trying to rescue him, and it is Samantha. So I tell Samantha. I have a form that is a fleshmancer. Bring my husband back in one piece and she can have any body she wants. I know who she really is.

beats.headline: A hunter wraith
beats.text: The halls in here move. The system knows where you're headed and makes one passage there for you. We got inside this castle a few times. We lost the asset who knew it best. We're not headed for the throne room. Not yet. I change into a hunter wraith. Where is he? Carl finds my husband on the map, in a line of cubicles, a room no bigger than a coffin, with Samantha on the other side of the wall. Got it. I'll tell him when I have Louis. I go invisible.

beats.headline: The Inevitable Ruin
beats.text: I put Louis on the cot and kiss his forehead. Carl says it seems strange that I love him. The first time, he had me become a Dewi, who looks into the hearts of men. He is genuine. He clings to every drop of happiness. He was my anchor. Then I possessed him as a hunter wraith, and its curse, the Inevitable Ruin, showed me the truth. He is terrified of me. He thinks NPCs fall for him because of some ability. He will never trust what I feel. Hopeless? Not even close, cowboy. Wait until you see what Justice Light has cooked up.

beats.headline: The long way round
beats.text: Louis comes out of the tent holding his throat. I say something to him and he says something back, and I put my hands to my face and turn away. Then, in chat: I will be leaving about ten seconds after everyone else. Carl wants to know where. Oh, I'm going to the twelfth floor all right. Justice Light and I are taking the long way. It's okay, Carl. Trust me. You'll like this one.

entities.name: Louis

tagline.text: Me and Firas were having a good time in a bar in Hump Town when Carl's crew walked in. Now he wants everybody at the Toe after the recap, and I guess we'll be there, Carl.
I've been walking through other people's portals since the fifth floor, and now it's Imani's, off the racing floor. It's never my portal, man, and honestly, I'm not complaining.

entities.voiceNote: Easygoing, a beat behind and fine with it. Okay so, man, no joke. Finds most things kind of funny, including the parts that aren't. Firas is his buddy. Never sounds scared, never sounds impressed, never plans further than the next thing.

beats.headline: We'll be there, Carl
beats.text: Okay so, me and Firas are in a bar in Hump Town, and the lady on my lap is doing Jessica Rabbit, which, much better than the slave Leia. Then Carl walks in. I told Firas that was Carl. He wants everybody at the Toe after the recap. The Toe, man. It's a camel town. Get it? Firas does not get it. I ask if he's gonna blow us up, and the cat jumps on the table, spills the vodka and calls us chuckleheads. We'll be there, Carl.

beats.headline: The Tiddy Twister
beats.text: Okay so, the van. My mom's Chevy Astro, top cut off, the Tiddy Twister, a hundred thousand likes. Five in the morning, driving back from Jojo's on I-95, road goes all jacked, glowing stairwell right there, slid right in. Broke the axle. Got a spell for being the first to drive a van into the dungeon: Cloud of Exhaust, level eleven. Me and Firas spray and run. Then the eagle hands us white potions with no description and I puke for like five minutes. Notification says I can't drink anymore. Not cool, man. It's all I got left.

beats.headline: Two levels off a camel
beats.text: Okay so, the frog plan. Firas jumps us up to a balcony, and we walk down the stairs like we work there, calm purpose, whatever that means. Carl throws a sparkler through the cat's hole, I cast the cloud, and two camels go down, only they're not camels, they're these faceless guys with glowing heads. Carl kills one. Then he tells me and Firas to hit the other one in the head. It wakes up. We hit it a bunch, the cat finishes it. I went up two levels. Firas is 24. Now we're holding a door.

beats.headline: The Twister, and a photo
beats.text: Okay so, the AI gave Carl pictures of a bunch of alien moms, and one of them is this angry bald elf lady with blue eyes and she's the hottest thing I've ever seen, so I ask Juice Box for another session where she looks like her. Carl rips the photo out of my hands. Also the house has a name now. The Twister. I wanted Tiddy Twister II, after my van, which was my mom's van until I chopped the top off, but Firas says we're trying to be more mature. And Katia wouldn't let us.

beats.headline: Riding the Twister through the storm
beats.text: Okay so, Carl wants me and Firas out in the storm, in the flying house, keeping behind the dog's heads while Donut heals it. In the storm, man. The balloon is slamming back and forth. Whiplash. It's like riding a bull, and Firas says he did that once and fell off. Then he sees half the bowl break away, the side with the Bactrian village, just gone. The net's shot, so we have to land to fix it. No choice. I'm up on the roof telling Carl this thing's going to fall out of the sky if we don't.

beats.headline: Juice Box told you, huh
beats.text: Okay so, Donut sits down next to me and wants to know when the nuptials are. She'll be maid of honor, Mongo's the ring bearer, Carl can officiate because he found religion, and she'll sing. For a fee, obviously. My face is on fire, man. Juice Box told you, huh? She didn't have to, Donut says. Love makes a person glow. Also, I'm level thirty-five and I'm an Extermination Professional now instead of a Pest Exterminator, which gets me half a percent insta-kill on mobs my level or lower. That's it. That's the upgrade.

beats.headline: Circled until the pencil broke
beats.text: Okay so, the Dream have one name on their list. One. The very last one, which is mine. Their dead guy circled it so many times the pencil went through the paper, and then drew my face at the bottom with a big X over it. Carl puts the whole map in the group chat and tells Katia she has to watch my back. Man, all I did was grab a photo of their boss's mom and ask Juice Box to turn into her. It's not my fault they can't take a joke.

beats.headline: The Voltron move
