beats.text: Okay so, I came up with a move on my own. I throw armor at Katia and it equips itself the second it lands, if she has the slot open. Now picture her huge, no breastplate, and we drop a giant one on her from the Twister, and she gets even bigger, then a bigger helmet. Like Voltron. Sort of. Britney says if it misses, Katia gets crushed. It's a work in progress, man. Carl says it's a good idea. Just be careful.

beats.headline: Tent the House
beats.text: Okay so, my Extermination Professional class has this thing called Tent the House. I take a potion and spread it over, like, a whole area, and from the deck of the Twister even wider. Once every six hours, so three goes before dark if we start now. Mordecai says maximum distance, man. Also Mongo has a girlfriend and she's pink, and she's a lot bigger than him. You go, buddy. I grab the last two jugs on my way out.

beats.headline: Kill credit, Louis Santiago 2
beats.text: We tent the house from the Twister and the creeper goes down, and the system gives the kill to Louis Santiago 2, which is me. Firas says it poked a bunch of holes in the garden with thorns like ballista bolts. Elle says level 173 and most fun she's had all floor. Carl says go for the one fifteen miles west when my spell resets. I don't know if I can stomach that again, man.

beats.headline: 600 of them outside
beats.text: Level 42 now, almost double what I was when I met Carl. My blood bar's only half full from sitting in the guild, so I gotta get back out there with Firas and Britney. Then Samantha does this Hannibal thing with her tongue at me, man. So the map: if every hunter's at this party, that's like 600 of them outside the doors when it's over, and like a hundred of us. We'll get our asses kicked.

beats.headline: Nobody asked me not to
beats.text: Everybody's signing Carl's plan in the bathroom thing. Katia, Imani, Elle says Jesus Christ, Carl, you're going to get us all killed. Donut hates the paper. Florin wants Lucia Mar. I write that nobody has tried to convince me not to go down the stairs, and I think we should. Firas writes same.

beats.headline: The boombox
beats.text: Okay so, Donut made me do it. I built her a boombox out of Carl's trap modules so it's not so loud, and I'm hidden backstage doing the voice, like a monster truck rally. It's Mongo! Carl wants to know how many trap modules I used. Hang on a second, man, don't get madder. Two of his smoke bombs go off too. Then I can't figure out how to turn the music off, and he has to give me instructions over chat.

beats.headline: The Twister is taken
beats.text: I figured out the tunnels on the castle map. They're not ducts, they're how the queen's cat gets around, like the ones Jojo's grandma had, and one goes right into the security room. Tonight I'm on chat helping the Sledge fly the Twister, and the mantises take it. They're all onboard. The changelings turned to birds and left, and the Sledge had to jump. He says he's got the controller and can crash it into the turrets, like in GTA. Don't crash the Twister, man!

beats.headline: Reykjavik, and fifty YOOHOOs
beats.text: Okay, so, Reykjavik is actually snowy and icy, which is backwards from what I heard. I'm doing better. Britney's face hasn't healed, but she's been going out on her own and levelling really fast. Almost everybody from our bubble on the fifth floor died on the sixth. Langley and the car salesmen guys, Gwen, Firas. Also, Samantha. I put her in my chat, and she wrote YOOHOO like fifty times, and when I answered she asked me what I was wearing. Carl says mute her. In an hour Britney and I go on Dungeon Sidekicks.

beats.headline: Great. Just great.
beats.text: Donut messages me about Juice Box. My fiancée has gotten very scary, she says, so I had better tell her she's pretty every day and never eat potato chips in bed. So, okay. She really ripped the guy's head off? Donut says it was very bloody and gross, and that she did it dressed like that elf guy's mom, and it made him scream a lot. Great. Just great. Afterwards I'm at the big table in the Desperado Club with everybody, and I don't say much.

beats.headline: An achievement for a bucket
beats.text: So I'm holding the bucket. Katia's puking, like, every colour, and it keeps getting fuller and I don't know where it's all coming from, man. The waitress ignores me when I ask for another one. Then the croc guards won't let me take it into the bathroom. So I stick it in my inventory. And I get an achievement for storing a bucket of vomit.

beats.headline: Christmas on the island
beats.text: Okay so, it's Christmas Eve down here, man, and I want to know if we're all getting together once midnight passes. Carl says it isn't really Christmas, it's like early March or something. Oh man, really? It feels like we've been here a year. Donut says Carl hadn't even put his tree away when everything happened. Still, we should do something. Maybe we could give each other presents. Imani says let's make sure we all get our keys first.

beats.headline: Tonight it's Christmas
beats.text: Okay so, Carl walks in and says it's inappropriate, and for once I don't laugh. My best friend died. Imani's squad doesn't have a key, Tserendolgor doesn't have a key, and we all know what happens next. I've got a whole army of elves waiting to kill me on the ninth floor. Britney can't stop crying. So no, man. Tonight it's Christmas, and we're drinking eggnog. He looks at me, pulls a turkey out of his inventory, and says it isn't Christmas until we eat one.

beats.headline: Five skulls, and nearly the whole gang
beats.text: Okay so, Samantha hits me like a thrown football, and there goes all my air. Then Mongo nearly bowls over Britney, so that's everybody saying hi. Man, it's too bad Florin already went down the stairs, or it'd be the whole gang. I've got five player killer skulls over my head now, all from one attack. They look wrong up there. And this place really sucks, no joke. Carl wants to know how we got here, and Li Jun tells him it was Lucia Mar.

beats.headline: Sorry, cat lady
beats.text: Carl opens the door and the nun is right there, running at us screaming "Sinner!", and he zaps her with a wand and she just drops and slides up to his feet. I think I just crapped myself, no joke. Somebody has to finish it. I've already got five skulls and none of these guys have any, so I push past Carl and say sorry, cat lady, I never met you, and I put the dagger in. Then there's a spinning squiggle over my head, like a little tornado, and music starts. Uh-oh.

beats.headline: A box for outliving her
beats.text: Dude. Okay so, everyone's in the chat yelling, and the decks are still out because demons are everywhere, and I just got a Celestial box. For outliving a goddess. One who put a marked-for-death curse on me. No joke. Then Donut tells everybody to stop talking, because nobody can find Carl.

beats.headline: Firas's name for it
beats.text: My celestial box gives me an Airship Portal, which is an elevator up to a hangar, and a ship. Katia says it's not an airplane, more like a drone thing, a tilt rotor. It runs on a soul crystal, like the Twister. I named it Party Planner, 'cause that's what Firas wanted to call the Twister, and I told him it was stupid. It's a bomber, too. The System calls the model Casket in the Sky. Carl says it looks like a death trap. Katia said that too, especially after she read the description.

beats.headline: Game of Thrones stuff
beats.text: She's messaging me non-stop about getting married so our houses are bonded. It's all Game of Thrones stuff, man. Out loud she's all confident, but in the messages she's different. I think she's really scared, in over her head. Carl says I don't have to. I already told her I would. If the NPCs turn on us, we're screwed. So I stand up, take her hand, and say we should get married right away. Donut makes me say I love you. Then she makes me say it twice.

beats.headline: I wish my mom was here
beats.text: Changeling weddings come in two parts, which is kind of a relief. The small one is now, in the grimy entrance bar: no rings, no officiant, no singing, and Donut is mad about all three. Juice Box goes to her blank form and we hold hands. I catch Carl staring and tell him I wish my mom was here. Then we whisper vows we made up on the spot, in each other's ears. We'll say them out loud at the Confirmation, in about a month. And that's it. We're married.

beats.headline: The bombing run
beats.text: Okay so, we see the target. Lowering for the bombing run. Not too low, Carl says. In and out, into the fog. The bombs don't go on their trench, man, they go in a straight line right in front of it, to leave a crater, shower the guys inside with dirt and clear the traps out there. Holy shit, that was scary. I got hit with a few spells, but the shields held. Circling round to the rendezvous.

beats.headline: Grounded under the roof
beats.text: Okay so, we finished the repair from the inside, but the portal has to be fixed by hand from outside, or the whole hangar stays grounded. The door to it is on top of the castle, man. Anybody who goes up there is a prime target. So we stay grounded.

beats.headline: They showed me a video
beats.text: Okay so, Victory and Drick have me in the privacy bubble for the live update, and then they show me a video of me and Juice Box together. I was having her do Erza, and, man, it's great when you're doing it, but watching it back is something else. I come out a little freaked out. Carl says get to Area 52, make sure everything's properly loaded, keep in contact with Donut, low and fast, in and out. Then he says change of plans, hang out, we'll talk. No, no, you're right. I gotta get to work.

beats.headline: Bombs away over King's Point
beats.text: Okay so, Britney says the Semeru are waiting on my run. Heigh ho, silver. Every bomb on board arms itself, Carl makes them extra, and I dump the whole load in seconds, the square No Disassembles and then the Waffle Makers. Shields crack like eggs. A green death ray misses us by a hundred feet and hits the ceiling of the floor. You missed, man. Then the dwarves agitate the lava tubes, and the orcs threw a backup shield over the mountain, and the top of it blows, and we are way too close.

beats.headline: Tell Katia I'm sorry
beats.text: Okay so, I'm going down. Feather falling. I hit the dragon with the missiles and it just got pissed and ripped Party Planner in half, and the bombs fell out before they were armed. I think my door gunners are dead. Glad Bonnie and Skarn weren't here. That cop's husband was right, man. Tell Katia when she wakes up I'm sorry to be such a fuckup. I sent Juice Box a message, but she's still in that meeting. Reaver security is tracking me. I'm landing right in the middle of their castle.

beats.headline: Gills, man
beats.text: Okay so, I wake up coughing, and water comes out of my neck. Gills, man. Where am I? Mordecai tells me to switch off the water-breathing notification. I did already, when I woke up. But something's wrong. I feel weird. Everybody claps anyway. Then Samantha zips up, says we're cousins now, and kisses me on the lips. And Mongo spits a chewed-up plastic heart and lungs onto the floor of the tent.

beats.headline: Divorce papers
beats.text: Juice Box left me. She gave me divorce papers. Donut tells me to get in the stairwell. No way, man. I gotta say goodbye to Katia. Then Katia wakes up, and the goddess says the father has to be human, and Katia asks if I'd be willing. Am I still human? I touch my neck. The goddess says of course, and a good soul at that. Then sure, I guess. If she'll have me. It'll be a boy. Spoilers.

beats.headline: The lowrider
beats.text: Okay so, our truck is an older Tahoe, which sounds fine, except it's a neon lowrider with like two inches of clearance, so we kept bottoming out. There's a hydraulic system. I didn't know how it worked. Britney says I drive like an American. We came in second-to-last, and we'd have lost if the tentacle guys hadn't gotten eaten, so the audience picked our upgrade, and they picked wheel spinners. They light up the road. It does have a great sound system, though. Tran's stuck in his garage with a hearse and some wrecked spider legs.

beats.headline: Last again, and still no tires
beats.text: Okay so, we made it, man. Me, Britney, Bautista. Last of the survivors again, which means the audience votes our upgrade again. Our replacement team was more NPCs and we took them out right at the start, no joke. Still no proper tires, though, which is kind of the whole thing with a race. Next track's called Satan's Water Park, and Prepotente's team is on it with us. Honestly? Could be worse.

beats.headline: First place, for once
beats.text: Okay so, we're in first place in our heat. For once. Prepotente's in first first. Before the race Bodi went into Hungry Eyes alone and ate, like, a thousand things, and his buffs make Eileen go really fast. Eileen's our lowrider. I didn't name her. Our track is waterslide tubes, and there's this Satan guy who keeps hoping none of the tubes lead to his butthole. Sweety loves the tubes. Also, the bat dudes are selling acid rain protection. Get it before it's gone.

beats.headline: A gecko in the garage
beats.text: Okay so, we won a key, and I used it, and now there's a gecko in my garage. Like a whole second ride. I did what Carl said and checked for the hidden room in the house, and there was an engineer in there, which is, no joke, a great find. There were also mobs in the house. Nobody mentioned the mobs. Be careful if you're doing it, man. Anyway. Pretty sweet.

beats.headline: Like trading a Pokémon
beats.text: Okay so the plan is basically Li Na goes in a pet carrier, the robot sucks up the pet carrier, the robot gets sold, and some guy on the other side opens it. It's like trading a Pokémon between devices, man. Donut was not into that comparison. Also I named the robot. Suckira, after my mom's vacuum in Florida. It was a fair coin flip, no matter what Samantha says. She says she cheated for me, because that's what a woman does for her man. Please stop sticking your tongue in my gills.

beats.headline: An upgrade thief
beats.text: Dude, that sucked. We came in last place again, but we made it, and we got this awesome engineer lady. She's an upgrade thief. She takes upgrades off somebody else's car and puts them on yours, which, no joke, is the best job. A ton of people didn't make it, man. But Britney ripped the head off one of the skeleton-astronaut things with her bare hands, so, you know. Some good news.

beats.headline: Go check up on my kid
beats.text: Okay so, Bautista's heading out with the Cabaret group, maybe to India after, and I'm handing out cookies, and I tell him, hey, you can go check up on my kid. Which, yeah. Wrong thing to say, man. Donut sucks in a breath and Carl messages me that it was the wrong thing to say. Bautista just looks at me for a long time. Then he grins, pats my arm, calls me brother, and says he'll check on the child I'm having with his girlfriend. So we're good.

beats.headline: My mom's apartment
beats.text: This is bull, man. My mom doesn't even live in an apartment. But her stuff is here, and she's a giant, and the name over her head says Lady Bird, which is her name, and also says shell. There's a picture of me on the wall graduating college, which I never did, and I'm way thinner. Then I see me. Actual me, walking around, in, like, good shape, and no X over my eyes. Dude. This is bizarre.

beats.headline: You're never going to see me again
beats.text: Samantha's zipping around my head, blowing into my gills, saying she's going to tea-bag me, and she only just asked what that means, man. So I tell her the thing I've been not telling her. Stop. I'm leaving. You're never going to see me again. Then Chris goes through the portal, and Britney jumps in right after him, and I'm next, and she's crying on my arm, and I don't really know what to do with that.

beats.headline: Out through Imani's portal
beats.text: Racing floor. Some of us drew heats with other crawlers in them, which is the bad kind of heat, and Carl's got a plan for it, because of course he does. Imani has the portal open again. So me and everybody else from the mixed heats are going through it. Not my portal. It's never my portal. I've been walking through other people's doors since the fifth floor and, honestly, no complaints.

beats.headline: Entering Sheol
beats.text: Okay so, that was not the Pineapple Cabaret. I stepped into the storage and for a nanosecond, or years, man, I dreamed about my mom telling me I'm rotting. Then: Entering Sheol. The fifteenth floor. You can't skip floors, everybody knows that. It's hot. Britney's here with her pickaxe, and Pontiff, and a little red demon called Forkith puts a leech on me so I don't die. Chris is being held down. Werewolf, apparently. Soldiers, the demon says.

entities.name: Tran

tagline.text: I'm Tran, a Swashbuckler with a metal-detecting ability. The only metal out here is the wheel that opens the drainage pipe, and a ring underneath it that I took for a handhold.
Gwen told me when, and I opened the valve, only part of the way. The necropolis drained out through the castle, and the two crawlers trapped underneath it went with the water.
Vadim ran, so it was Carl, Katia and me against Lusca and all her babies, and we killed them. Then Carl opened the Gate, and one step took the three of us out of the water quadrant and into town.

entities.voiceNote: Few words, all of them load-bearing. What happened, then what the options were, in that order, no decoration on either. Dry rather than grim. Carl, Katia, Gwen by first name. Never speculates, never boasts, never says how he feels about any of it.

beats.headline: He opens the valve
beats.text: Carl and Donut are under the sand in the castle's basement, and the ceiling is about to come in. Carl sends Gwen a note. I open the valve, only part way. The water in the necropolis comes out through the drain the castle is built around, the castle washes away like sand under a hose, and everything in there, the two of them included, goes with the water into the ocean.

beats.headline: One of the three who go through the Gate
beats.text: Vadim ran. That leaves Carl, Katia and me against Lusca and all of her babies, and we kill her, and then we kill them. Then Carl opens the Gate. One step and the three of us are out of the water quadrant and standing in town. Something came through behind us. A god, the feral kind. That is going to be somebody's problem.

beats.headline: Anser's tomb
beats.text: Gwen, me and the team go into the subterranean level now it is dry. We loot what is left of the tomb raiders. Electrifying the water set off every trap. The tomb of Anser: a sarcophagus, the skeleton of a goose, a golden crown, unenchanted. Quetzalcoatlus's corpse has a partial map of the sixth floor, with coordinates for several locations.

beats.headline: The legs do not grow back
beats.text: Katia tells Carl that Daniel and I are getting hammered in the fight with the queen. We are. Gwen is dead, beside the knock-knock joke man. My legs are gone. I drag myself away, screaming. Carl reads a scroll over me and it heals me. The legs do not grow back.

beats.headline: A floating chair
beats.text: Final moments of the last floor, I lost my legs. And Gwen. We'd been together since early on. Bautista is with me, helping. I open my boxes. The pacifist box has a floating wheelchair, the same sort Odette used to zip around in when she was in human form. Carl sends a note asking if I'm okay. I don't answer.

beats.headline: The wheelchair goes off
beats.text: The roof gives out under us and I fall down to a different level. The wheelchair is sparking. I'm stuck in it and it's going to blow. Louis and Britney keep running, because the monk seal is after Louis. The rock monster the demon summoned first, the one that crashed through the ceiling, is down here too. The wheelchair blows a hole in its chest. That was the last of his totems. I need a healer.

beats.headline: Blow the line
beats.text: Katia finished my chair. Two parts. A crab body for walls and short sprints, and a battle shell that closes over it up to a helmet, so much metal I can't carry a ranged weapon or the system calls me armour. The pets hit the dirt wall. I call for my moles. They go down the holes and come back faster than expected. Fire in the hole. The whole line goes up, and the dirt hangs over us on the shields. We set those explosives two hours ago. We were saving them.

beats.headline: The southern map
beats.text: Their trenches, here. The Dream's artillery on the hills: about forty big trebuchets, dozens of small ones. Fifty zebras with mercenary riders, held in reserve. Twenty tanks that have not moved since they were uncovered. A hundred of the Madness gone invisible. The first trench is NPCs and mercenaries, mostly Prism banners, one naga standard. No inner-circle officers. Their fallback trenches are a hundred metres apart, no tunnels we know of. I still don't understand why they get trebuchets and we don't.

beats.headline: Five teams of twenty-four
beats.text: If this is my last message, know that I tried to stop them fighting Li Na. I tried. Then, after: I'm alive. We won. Zhang was leading their octopus and let me pass. They tried to stop her, and it went the way it went in Beijing. She cast a dread and they killed each other. Of twenty-four teams that started, five are left. From our heat, only my team and theirs. Zhang needs help. He was sobbing. I don't know what to do.

beats.headline: Not bad, just lost
beats.text: Zhang says it's his fault. It isn't. It isn't all Na's, either. They attacked her. Rezan was an ass, and the decapitator had it coming. She didn't take player-killer skulls, because it was her dreads that did it, and they all killed each other. Zhang wants to kill their mount mid-race so the system takes them both. Carl says that won't work any more: Na just loses containment and reaches the line without one. She isn't killing for fun. She's lost her humanity. Those are different problems.

beats.headline: A red shirt for the Cabaret
beats.text: Two hundred of us are going to the Pineapple Cabaret, and I am one of them, spider legs and all. Carl calls Zhang and me generals. Zhang reminds him he was only ever made colonel. Carl says he sees I'm wearing a red shirt now. I hold out my arms and ask how he likes it. Donut headbutts me. Then Bautista pours the tea. That is the goodbye. It is enough of one.

tagline.text: Ferdinand is a name Princess Donut drops when she pictures herself matted and filthy. Nobody has told Crawler Carl who he is.

Under a Buzzed debuff, Princess Donut has told Crawler Carl that she loves him, though not as much as Miss Beatrice, and not as much as Ferdinand. The file on Ferdinand is thin, and I opened it for the ranking.

Ferdinand's real name is Gravy Boat, and he was the downstairs neighbour's tomcat. Now he is familiar to Queen Imogen of the High Elves, and he has just attacked Mongo. Princess Donut put herself in the way, and the reunion went about as well as you would expect, crawler.

beats.headline: Named in a drunken confession
beats.text: Crawler Princess Donut, under the Buzzed debuff from a blended corpse, informs Crawler Carl that she loves him. Almost as much as Bea. Almost as much as Ferdinand. Ferdinand is the other cat. That is the whole entry: a cat, ranked above the man who carried her down the stairs, by a cat. I keep records on everything in this dungeon. This one I opened for the ranking.

beats.headline: His name was Gravy Boat
beats.text: A caller on Danger Zone asks Princess Donut who Ferdinand is. The answer given is the love of her life: a star-crossed ruffian, branded a Moggie, hunted by the authorities, who called to her from outside the window. Carl identifies him as the creepy yellow cat that came to the window when she was in heat. His name was Gravy Boat, and he belonged to Marjory on the first floor. Animal control never managed to catch him. "He preferred Ferdinand," says Donut.

beats.headline: Gravy Boat
beats.text: Subject is on Earth. His real name is Gravy Boat. He is Beatrice's neighbour's cat, who used to yowl at her window when Princess was in heat; she called him Ferdinand to shoo him off. She found him in a tree beside the hole where her building was, skin and bones. He is also an A-tier target on the season's Walk-On list, and two bounty hunters have scanned six cats in the area looking for him. Odette's orders: a bounty cube, and a delivery to Borant.

beats.headline: Familiar to Queen Imogen
beats.text: Update to the file. The party runs into the High Elves. The High Elves have a queen, Queen Imogen, and the queen has a familiar, and the familiar is Ferdinand. Yes. That Ferdinand. He attacks Mongo. Crawler Princess Donut puts herself between the blast and her dinosaur and lives only because of a cockroach ability, which is not a sentence I expected to generate this season. Some families skip the reunion. This one held it anyway, and it went about how you'd think.

beats.headline: The sir is part of his name
beats.text: Background from the caravan to the castle. Queen Imogen's familiar is Sir Ferdinand, rarely off her shoulder when not hunting away from the castle. The footman Theobold is firm that the title is not a title: a familiar, a pet, a lowly creature, the sir simply part of the name. Crawler Carl mentions that Ferdinand implied, out in the woods, that he was second in charge of the kingdom. You must be mistaken, says Theobold. Carl advises him to watch the cat.

beats.headline: On Carl's other shoulder
beats.text: A heavy weight lands on Carl's shoulder, the one Princess Donut is not standing on. Ferdinand, familiar of Queen Imogen, has come out of nowhere, and he repeats Florin's question back at Carl in a mocking voice: yeah, mate, you feeling okay? Carl's answer goes to Samantha, not to the cat. He's distracted, it says. Go, go, go.

beats.headline: The royal hat
beats.text: Sir Ferdinand, level 100 Province Boss, arrives in a gold turban with a white feather four feet high, and the crawlers around Carl laugh at him. It is his royal hat. It makes him the most handsome boy in the castle, and it carries a level-10 lightning spell. Charmed, he lets slip that the queen has him watching her sister and means to kill her once the party is over. Then he decides to visit Princess Donut in person, and bounds from the room.

beats.headline: I'll protect you, my bride
beats.text: The seal breaks, and Ferdinand, charmed to the whiskers, shouts up at the stage that he will protect his bride, and blinks out. When Imogen has Carl in the air with his bones snapping, the orange form of the cat slams into her head. She staggers and drops Carl, then backhands her own familiar across the room, the cat going one way and his hat the other. He hits the ground, yowls and disappears.

beats.headline: Ferdinand and his Bird
beats.text: Warlord Donut accepts Team Retribution's truce offer while her co-warlord is still in the middle of a sentence urging her to wait, and names the truce The Good Guys. Warlord Ferdinand of Team Retribution renames it Ferdinand and his Bird. The system does not let her change it back. The alliance itself stands: allied with the defenders, her crawlers will not be removed from Larracos when the ceasefire ends.

beats.headline: A bowler hat for Shanty Town
beats.text: Warlord on High, Sir Ferdinand, level 100, co-warlord of Team Retribution, arrives in the vestibule seated on his adjutant's head, in a turban improvised from tissues. He wants his rhinoceros mount and his hat. Carl offers a temporary replacement from Quan Ch's inventory, a bowler hat that decapitates and returns when thrown, in exchange for the mayorship of Shanty Town. The transfer requires Carl and Donut to pay gold. The trade is accepted, and the truce is renamed The Good Guys. Subject's remark on the matter: I'm a very handsome boy.

beats.headline: Five seconds of absolute chaos
beats.text: Warlord Ferdinand arrives at the production facility with five seconds of absolute chaos: don't hit me, I'm sorry, off the corner, across the room, off Carl's shoulder, circles, ears pinned. Then he sits up straight. How goes the war, kitten? No hat. He smells of smoke and alcohol and has not been grooming. A gnoll guard scans him while he hisses that he has his claws, you cur, and when the guards leave he tells them they are lucky they didn't get the slish slash. He wants to know where the snacks are.

beats.headline: An emergency action item
beats.text: Sir Ferdinand of Team Retribution proposed an emergency action item: gods who appear in Faction Wars do not have to go home right away. Juice Box told him to say a number of other things. He could not remember them. The request was split in two. The first half was denied; deity summoning rules stay as written. The second was approved: ascendency players must now pilot their sponsored deities when they are summoned, and may no longer appear as themselves. A pilot who had stayed back was corrected on the spot.

beats.headline: Kitten is in trouble
beats.text: Crawler Carl dived into a ditch in Shanty Town to get out of a defence tower's line of fire. Subject jumped in beside him, shaking, tail scorched from a near miss, bowler hat askew, and asked why he was lying down on the job, because Kitten is in trouble. Carl told him that going into the tower would get him killed and that Juice Box needs him alive. Subject reported that Juice Box hates him and is meaner than Bill. Carl told him that he, and Donut, want him alive too.

beats.headline: Anytime, babe
beats.text: Warlord Ferdinand turns up on Drick's bald head, wearing the bowler hat Princess Donut let him keep, to say yo before moseying down to the twelfth floor to bang some hot goddess chicks. He offers her a last-second fling. There are about four minutes, which he considers more than enough. She declines. Then she thanks him for trying to come save her in the tower. Anytime, babe. His transfer, with Juice Box's, is what defeats Team Retribution and hands the war to the Princess Posse.

beats.headline: Apartment 231, and a man named Bill
beats.text: The mandatory gate for Crawler Carl sits in apartment 231: a first-floor unit in his own building, not his own. On the couch, Marjory Williams and a friend, both with stitched eyes, discussing a man named Bill who keeps calling in breach of a restraining order. He drained her account, the friend says, broke her face, nearly killed her cat. The cat, large and orange, sleeps on top of the scratching tree the whole time. Here he is called Gravy Boat. Here, nobody wakes him.

entities.name: Emberus

tagline.text: I am Emberus. Someone has let my hound out, and I will wreck every broken bubble on this floor until he is returned to me.
My son's hound is lost on this floor. The dungeon has made a quest of bringing him to me, and another of killing him first, and I am interested to learn which the small things choose.

A man falling out of the sky, with nothing in his hands but a celestial grenade, decided that he worships me. I was not fooled, but I was flattered, and I came. For a little while nothing on this floor could kill him. Then I took my hound home.

entities.voiceNote: A god. Grand, unhurried, amused; mortals are small, brief and occasionally entertaining. Complete, rounded sentences, and no embarrassment about referring to himself. Orthrus is 'my hound'. Carl is 'the man' until he does something worth a name. Never rushed, never afraid, never explains himself to anything that will not outlive him.

beats.headline: A quest to bring Orthrus home
beats.text: My son's hound is lost. Orthrus. I believe he is in the eighteenth of these little glass worlds, so I stand outside it and pound on the wall while everything inside turns to lava. The dungeon has made a quest of him: bring him to me. It has made another, for anyone who would rather be paid: kill him before he reaches me. I am interested to learn which the small things choose.

beats.headline: Summoned by a celestial grenade
beats.text: The man is falling out of the sky with Quan Ch a breath from finishing him, and in that moment, with nothing in his hands but a celestial grenade, he decides that he worships me. I am not fooled. I am flattered, which is a different thing, and I answer. I come to where he is. For a little while nothing on this floor can kill him, because I have said so. And there is Orthrus. Good boy. We are leaving.

beats.headline: His worshippers in the hunters' ranks
beats.text: The mantis brought me to Zockau early, briefly, and so its guards may worship me, and that was her notion of keeping the man out. Some hunters who saw me that day now pray to me as well, for the same reason. The man killed one of mine from afar. I cancelled his boon, gave him fifteen hours of Penitence and doubled his tithe, and told him two more would earn a smite. He wore Shunned over his head, and the cat enjoyed it.

beats.headline: Do not be gentle
beats.text: Nekhebit has returned to the halls. She holds an ancient grudge against my family, and against Apito most of all, and so the quest to find out who killed my son moves forward. I set the man a task: find a temple of Nekhebit and put questions to the priestess there. See what she knows. I have one further instruction, and I give it plainly. Do not be gentle.

beats.headline: The man is made a Devotee
beats.text: The man has walked through fire in a burning trailer, and I am pleased by his suffering. So I raise him. Devotee, which is as high as one who is neither Cleric nor Paladin may climb. Heat and lava around him will no longer harm him, though fire or lava he touches still may. Once a day he may wrap himself in Sheol Fire at the tenth level, resetting with my shrine. And his tithe rises from five parts in a hundred to ten.

beats.headline: Permission to break the truce
beats.text: Amayon, Prince of Sheol, claims to know what happened to my son, and he offers it in exchange for the deaths of his three brothers. The gods and the demons have a truce. I do not wish to break it, and I will do what is necessary to learn the truth. There is a way to do it without a war that burns the mortal world to ashes. My martyr will go to the Temple of Issitoq in a Club Vanquisher and gain permission from the High Cleric of the Watch. He still owes me the Soul Crystal of Apito. Do not disappoint me now.

beats.headline: Kill the Blasphemer
beats.text: A ram at the door of Club Vanquisher, a worshipper of my brother, proposes to give half of my own man's bounty to Hellik, as the superior god to his filthy Emberus. I have been insulted, and I say so. New quest: Kill the Blasphemer. This worshipper of Hellik has insulted me. Kill him. The reward is an additional boon, and the more entertained I am by the manner of it, the better the boon will be. The man looks up into the air and tells me he is one step ahead of me.

beats.headline: Am I wrong to hate him?
beats.text: New quest, for the man: kill one hundred worshippers of Hellik before the twelfth floor. Fuck my brother to the fires of Sheol. And then, more quietly: am I wrong to hate him? He has treated with Issitoq on our behalf, who has allowed the peace to be breached, and I may now kill the other Sheol princes in exchange for what Amayon knows about Geyrun. What does he mean about our mother and sister? Be vigilant, my martyr. If you survive killing Hellik, I fear I may turn my rage and grief on you for hurting my kin. I promise the burning will be exquisite.

beats.headline: Bring my enemy to me
beats.text: This so-called Psamathe claims she was part of my son's death. Capture her for me, and I will handle the interrogation personally. Once I have finished grilling her, I will cleanse this world in fire to remove the stink of the murderer's presence. If she is not within my presence in sixty-six minutes, this world will be destroyed in fire and lava and wrath. Fly, martyr. Bring my enemy to me.

beats.headline: Summoned into the club
beats.text: The man sends word that he knows who killed my son and will show me the proof. I come at once, at a man's size, into the club inside the great worm, and wait for him among the dead. He brings a pig and a name: Khepri. That false sun god was always jealous of me. Show me the proof, I tell him. Instead he takes my ring off his finger, abandons my faith, and tells me he killed my son himself, with his bare hands, and why.

beats.headline: A memorial crystal made by his death
beats.text: The last boss of the eleventh floor is down and the stairwells to the twelfth are open. In the wreckage, Crawler Carl has picked up a memorial crystal. It is not the one he was hoping for. This one formed when the god Emberus died. Yes. Gods die here now. A patron is only as permanent as whatever kills him, and this one answered a prayer from a falling aeroplane once. What answered is now in Carl's inventory.

entities.name: Miriam Dom

tagline.text: I'm fifth on the board, with two hundred thousand on my head: human, Shepherd, level twenty-seven. I don't travel alone.
Prepotente and I travel together. He says things he doesn't mean; he was always a little ornery, even before the change.
I'm a vampire now. I was a vegan before all this, and whoever cursed me thought that was very funny. It hasn't changed how I feel about my boy, which is the part I was afraid of.
Prepotente's ring marked me in the fighting, and while I live, he can't heal. I've asked Carl to do the one thing he won't do, so we sit together and wait for the sun.

entities.voiceNote: Calm, unhurried, a little formal, maternal without fuss. Prepotente is Prepotente or my boy, never the goat, and she explains him to others with patience and no apology. Plain declaratives; hard things said once, gently, and then set down. Never asks for pity and never raises her voice.

beats.headline: Same plan, other side of the Tangle
beats.text: We worked it out some time ago: the ghouls keep coming while the generators stand, so the generators have to go, every one of them. We have been taking them from this side of the knot, Prepotente and I, at his pace, which is patient. He puts debuffs on a thing for hours and waits for it to fall. Now Carl's group arrives from the far side with the same plan, and they have just dropped into the abyss the boss my boy was two hours from finishing. He threatens them for it. I take my staff to the top of his head until he apologises, and I tell them all that two groups landing on the same plan only means the plan is good.

beats.headline: Karaoke, and then the curse
beats.text: They put me on a show with Katia and have the two of us sing karaoke. While I am gone, Prepotente has a panic attack and goes berserk and runs off. When I get back I go looking for my boy, and that is when something attacks me and curses me. I was a vegan before all this. The curse has made me a vampire, and I understand the people who chose it for me thought that was very funny.

beats.headline: A vampire now
beats.text: I am a vampire now, and the leaderboard says so. It changes a great many things. It has not changed how I feel about my boy, which is the part I was afraid of. We bring Carl out of the city in the back of a cart, with Bianca hauling it, and while he comes round the cat tells him what Mordecai has said: the Ring of Divine Suffering is addictive. I hope Carl listens. Men with a tool that works rarely do.

beats.headline: The caravan road is clear
beats.text: We are on the main road south, sweetie, following the path of the caravans, and there are very few mobs about. The bodyguards on the caravans cast anti-trap spells as they travel, so even the traps made for crawlers are disarmed. We plan to cross the river soon and disappear into the jungle. Yes, there is a town near the bridge, a very big one, a large Ursine settlement on the far side, forty kilometres from Carl. It is where we started. Be careful there. They are very peculiar. We have to put Bianca away when we enter.

beats.headline: Trapped under his arm
beats.text: The elite is dead and the quest is done. My boy killed him and was paralysed doing it, and the elite only died a few minutes ago, when the sun set. The paralysis was thirty-five hours; fifteen remain. His arm is around my waist, and if any part of him breaks, even his thumb, he will shatter. Bianca is in a carrier in his inventory. Through the daylight I alternated Revive and blood potions, and I have a handful left. I have asked for help for hours. The system would not let my messages reach Carl.

beats.headline: It is spreading through the forest
beats.text: Carl asks whether we fought a giant dinosaur in a pink feathered necklace. We did. She carried a wand. I almost killed her, and then something happened and she escaped. He thinks I infected her. Yes. I know. Many of the dinosaurs in this area are vampires now, and it is spreading quickly. They are weak for the first few days, if they survive, and then they grow strong. It was part of the elite's story. He died before it could be stopped. You must help me.

beats.headline: Marked by his ring, waiting for the sun
beats.text: Carl and Donut have found us. Prepotente is paralysed, with his arm still around my waist. In the last fight his Ring of Divine Suffering marked me. That is how it works: while I live, he cannot heal. And I am the head of this, so when I go, everyone it has touched is cured. I have asked Carl to do it before the paralysis wears off. He has said no. So we sit, and we wait for the sun.

beats.headline: Dust at sunrise
beats.text: Crawler Miriam Dom has been eliminated in a forest clearing on the sixth floor. Cause of death: sunlight, which she waited for. She had summoned the man to kill her. He declined, and stood watch with her instead. She died with her head on Prepotente's frozen shoulder, saying "my beautiful boy" twice. Bounty unclaimed: 300,000 gold.

beats.headline: A salve for the guildmaster
beats.text: Pony will not stand for what they have done, and there are guards down in the hall, and Bianca melting another. We go through a hidden door into a little guild, and Bianca burns the guildmaster before I can stop her. Pony, give me a salve. I ask what kind of creature she is, and rub it into her arm myself. She was a crawler once. She says she hopes we will not threaten her, because if we do, she might be forced to give us information. I thank her with a hand on her shoulder, and take out a knife.

beats.headline: Answered for
beats.text: Update to the file of Crawler Miriam Dom, deceased on the sixth floor, cause of death a programme called Blood Hunter, filed under entertainment. From the ninth: most of the Naga army is dead as well. That was Prepotente, and he did it as payment for her, all of it, at a rate he set himself. If you were hoping the goat would grieve quietly, crawler, you have not been paying attention.

entities.name: Prepotente

tagline.text: I am Prepotente, a Caprid and a Forsaken Aerialist, third on their leaderboard. The man in sixth place has the gall to ask who I am.
Yes, I am a goat. I am a walking, talking goat, I am third on your board, and I am cleverer than you. Move along.
They built a seventh floor out of glass tunnels with nothing holding it up, so I tested it. Minutes after it opened, it was dust, and not one crawler set hoof in it. Build a better one.
They made a programme out of Miriam and called it Blood Hunter, so I went through the Naga army until there was very little army left. I am not finished.

entities.voiceNote: Sharp, clipped, contemptuous; every line sounds like a correction. A nasal, faintly British, spoiled-prince drawl. Humans, idiots, you people; Carl by name, Miriam by name and nothing softer. Never thanks, never apologises, never asks.

beats.headline: On the recap
beats.text: They have put me on their recap, the programme between floors, in a row with humans. The captions say Elle, Li Na's team, Ifechi, Florin, Hekla, Lucia Mar. And Miriam Dom, of course, since she is the one who walked me into this place. I did not ask for the camera and I do not smile for it. If the audience wants a goat that performs, the audience can wait until I feel like singing, and then it can sit very still and listen.

beats.headline: Deprived of my prey
beats.text: I had the province boss asleep and entranced, and I was lowering its blood pressure toward cardiac arrest. Two more hours. Its death would have blown soul crystals through the whole system and let everyone down. Instead a portal takes it, and through the hole I find Carl, a colossal dolt, and the cat. The cat is delightful; we are the only two Earth creatures left in here with true sapience. I tell the woman beside him I could crunch her bones. Miriam strikes me with her staff and has me say I am sorry I wanted to murder them.

beats.headline: Debuff stacking, ruined
beats.text: Watch the highlights from the last floor, since they insist on replaying them. Miriam and I are stacking debuffs onto a boss, one on top of the other, timed to the second, the way it is supposed to be done and the way nobody else in this dungeon can do it. Then Quan Ch walks into the middle of it, and the plan is gone. The best work I have done in this place, and that is the part they replay.

beats.headline: Third, above the cat
beats.text: Miriam and I scale the inside wall of our bubble. A debuff puts the spiders to sleep, and they plummet to their deaths, every one of them, and somehow that finishes the subterranean zone as well. Now we go underwater. The list is posted: third, Prepotente, Caprid, Forsaken Aerialist, level thirty-eight, four hundred thousand. Carl is second. The cat is fourth.

beats.headline: The club revokes Miriam
beats.text: The club revokes Miriam's membership because she is a vampire now. As if that were her doing, as if any of you idiots chose what you are. So I let our third companion loose in the main lounge. It devoured a number of clerics before the rest had the sense to flee. There is a Holy Crusade Bounty on the three of us now, whatever that is supposed to mean, and the club is shut while they cleanse it.

beats.headline: The turkey
beats.text: The feral turkey god. Level 150, tripled in size from eating what was left of another god, sitting on a popped bubble and screaming. Miriam and I take it apart with our debuffs. It gives me eight levels, which makes me 55, the highest in the dungeon, which should surprise nobody. The recap shows me gnawing the largest feather in the universe and screaming, over and over, while Miriam strokes my hair.

beats.headline: He ruined my spell. Again.
beats.text: Again. He has done it again. Mother and I have been at work on a spell over that city, and now this idiot is lying at the edge of the jungle with bolts through his leg and his shoulder and a stack of debuffs. Level fifty-four. How did this idiot get so high? And what are those knife symbols over his head? Mother, you should feed on him before he dies. She will not. I say we let him die. He ruined my spell. Again. You need blood.

beats.headline: Tripper, tears and a hug
beats.text: There is a line of traps at the town entrance built to decapitate anyone who comes near, and they require a special touch. I am explaining this to Carl, who cannot manage his own basic hygiene, when he casts something and sets off every trap at once. That was an attack. Negligence most serious. I prepare Bianca for battle, and he calls me by my special name, which only Mother may use. I weep into her robes. Mother says we must apologise. I apologise for calling him malodorous. Then we hug, and I scream in his ear.

beats.headline: He swallows the ring
beats.text: The cat's spell works, and I can move. I take the Ring of Divine Suffering off and drop it in the dirt. Then I pick it up again and swallow it. I scream at what is left of her until the sound will not come. Oh, mother, what did you do. She was going to play piano for me like she used to. She was going to sing me my special song. And now, it appears, my sponsor has sent me an emergency benefactor box.

beats.headline: Nobody responsible may exist
beats.text: A wand makes a safe space for three minutes, and I spend it opening my boxes. The legendary benefactor box holds a spray applicator and a recipe: fine healing, blessed water and a weedkiller, turned to mist. I take five potions from Carl as payment for the Size Up scrolls he stole from my mother. Then Bianca, with wings now, and a saddle. If I cannot exist in a world with my mother, nobody even remotely responsible for her death can exist in it either.

beats.headline: A package for the cat
beats.text: Level 70. Fifteen hunter-killer marks. Carl offers me a nap. I do not wish to rest or see his waste-of-money bathroom, and I do not wish to be involved in whatever he is planning. His idiot friends need not guard him; I wish him no harm. The floating one mentions goat recipes, so I scream in her face. Then I put the potion on the table. It came in my benefactor box. I cannot fathom why my sponsor would send me something meant for the cat. I leave.

beats.headline: He asks to join Carl's party
beats.text: I inform Carl that I must join his party. He says no, naturally. I am level seventy, I would lead any party I joined, and he suggests I found my own and join the guild. It would only be for the remainder of this floor, so we travel together to the start of the next. I have been collecting the clues, and Katia has told me about the cat's magical hammer and stick. Then a voice booms from the stage and I scream. He says we are bookmarking this.

beats.headline: Pole position, and a stage on fire
beats.text: I was the prize counter's first customer. Thirty-three hands. I walked up, pointed at the seventh floor's pole position, the skill upgrade and a case of mana potions, and took them. I did not ask what the flag does. Then the pet show. I take Bianca onto the stage and say nothing, because there is nothing to say. I scream once. She hisses. We leave, and the stage smoulders behind us and catches fire, and elves appear from nowhere to stamp out the flames.

beats.headline: One zap, for a day in charge
beats.text: Carl needs the potions out of his prize boxes, and there is no saferoom in the castle. I have a personal saferoom cube, and one zap left on my wand. I let him stand on the cube and use the zap, and he gets his potions out, and a great deal else. In exchange, he lets me take over his party for a day or so. When the seal breaks, I throw potion bottles into the nymphs.

beats.headline: Riding Bianca down
beats.text: Bianca cuts through the nymphs like a snowplow, and I am on her back, screaming, shields around me, throwing potion bottles into the fray. The queen's lightning finds Britney's butterflies instead and the blast sends Carl flying. I fly over him on Bianca. Then I jump off my mount with a bubbling potion in each hand.

beats.headline: Twenty-two percent
beats.text: I struck twenty-two percent of all the damage against the boss, I struck the killing blow, and I had first looting choice. The crystal is mine. The man with the hawk says it was on her body and he took it first, and calls me a murderer because Bianca ate his pet. It is a memorial crystal for the goddess Apito, which is impossible, because Apito ran that party. I have a quest regarding it. I am the party leader now, briefly. Carl calls me Pony. I scream in his face.

beats.headline: He shatters the seventh floor
beats.text: Look at what they gave us. The Great Race, a replacement the Valtay paid for and somebody threw together in a hurry, a circuit of glass tunnels with nothing holding it up. So I tested it. Minutes after it opened, the whole loop is dust, fine as flour. No crawler goes into their maze. No mob, no NPC, no boss gets to meet anyone. You wanted a seventh floor. Build a better one.

beats.headline: His mother's boots
beats.text: Carl asks how I really know. My mother's boots. Boots of Kiznet's Final Flight, from a minor boss just before Carl allowed her to kill herself. The description is five hundred and three percent longer than the average item's, and it tells a fairy tale: a boy in a maze where every tunnel seals behind him, resurrected and made to start over, who spends years trying to crack the walls. She played the piano for me. She was going to do it again at the talent competition. I am never going to get that back.

beats.headline: A giant bat, single-handed
beats.text: I am in the Bahamas, as I told the cat. Carl is to read me the lore book, since there will probably be some crossover with Cuba; that is the sensible use of him. Meanwhile I flag and capture a giant bat without anyone's assistance, and the recap shows it to everyone. When the list repopulates, I am at the top of it. The cat is second. Carl is third.

beats.headline: Typos in the transcription
beats.text: Carl reads me his Bahamas book at last: an hour of it, transcribed and sent over in chat. I do not thank him. When he asks whether I am actually receiving his messages, I reply to point out the typos in his translation.

beats.headline: Four squads, asleep
beats.text: I am back in the Bahamas along with four squads, which is quite unfortunate for them. If I set it up correctly, they are asleep and will remain asleep for the remainder of the floor. I am going to finish my training and proceed to the exit when it is time.

beats.headline: A red tinge over the Bahamas
beats.text: Carl demands to know whether the sky here has changed colour. There is a red, sunset-like tinge coming from his direction, and naturally he is involved. The zombie event killed every one of my opponents before I could get to them, and I inform him that the blood is on his hands. If he is involved, whatever happens next will be global, and not in a good way. He tells me to eat his ass. Then he calls me the smartest guy he knows. He does not want it to be local. He wants it over the whole world, and he wants ideas.

beats.headline: Fifty percent, then forty, then thirty-five
beats.text: Carl asks me to tell the others what I told him. I do. I have seen gated stairwell encasements break before; I once watched Lucia Mar try to teleport a stairwell, and I saw what happened to it and to the structure around it. His theory is sound. I will not risk it myself, and I am going down with my key momentarily, but I would put it at fifty percent. Perhaps forty. Katia's fumbled explanation raised the matter of spin while being sucked upward, so perhaps thirty-five. Then the quest arrives, as I said it would.

beats.headline: A penance, in lieu of a killing
beats.text: A parting message, before I take the stairs. I do hope Carl and Princess Donut survive this foolish endeavour; he is an oafish brute and the dungeon would not be the same without him. Read the winning conditions carefully. The crawlers in Indonesia, the nearest land to the far side of the Earth from Havana, are in the most danger if he does not buff that demon enough. I have also decided not to kill him for letting my mother hurt herself. He was too stupid to prevent it. His penance is to help me take my revenge on the true culprits.

beats.headline: A score to settle first
beats.text: Hello, Carl and Donut. I am above the naga border with Bianca, surveying your defences, and your enemies believe they are being surreptitious. The elves' long-range trebuchets are preparing to fire. A hundred mercenaries in the Madness's colours think they are invisible. There are tracked vehicles under camouflage netting. With no magic permitted at the outset, I am perfectly safe, thank you. Once the festivities begin, I have a score to settle with the lead producer of the Blood Hunter program. Only then will I join your military. If you are still alive.

beats.headline: He kills the Naga army
beats.text: Elle can give Carl the count. Most of the Naga army is already dead, and it did not take me long. They made a programme out of Miriam. They called it Blood Hunter, and she is what it cost. So I went through their army until there was very little army. Now some baroness tells Carl he cannot work with me unless I join his Princess Posse. Let them argue about it. I am not finished.

beats.headline: Big Red, and a map in my head
beats.text: Carl has not brought Donut. A contingency, he says. I mention, since nobody asked, that I have a map of all of Club Vanquisher. Miriam, Bianca and I befriended a delightful guildmaster inside, and we left through a bathroom stall in the entrance temple. Perfect recall. Then I drink my Big Red, which is from Texas, where cowboys live; I may have five soda pops a day, a hard rule of my mother's. At the door he hands me a smoke grenade and asks about my acting. Soon I am on the floor in fuzzy handcuffs that do not lock. I have been caught! Oh woe!

beats.headline: Dialling 453 for the bug god
beats.text: Katia cannot work the portal dial. It is just lights, she says. This mechanism is quite simple. Turn off automatic mode, or Carl arrives in the temple of Emberus, she in Eileithyia's, and I at the Epicure. Then the integers. Carl calls out 453. Before this I stopped to put some of the sentient blood running along the walls into a jar. At the door I say my litany of names under my breath: Miriam, and Bianca, and several others, ending on Ragazzaccia. I am ready for battle, Carl.

beats.headline: Who would have thought
beats.text: Your army people are marching on the castle, Carl, and the plan is working: a large host of Madness troops has come out to face us. However, whichever one of you shot that giant rainbow into the air has attracted the other half, and they are coming to meet you. Who would have thought that such a move would alert the enemy? I suspect you are about to be in extreme danger. Now he wants me on his side of the field. I will come as requested, Carl.

beats.headline: I will hug you now
beats.text: I found her. Li Na is in the woods, seeking those who got away. She appears to have new hunting skills and the ability to fly, likely a benefit of her dexterity. Curious that she cannot find those she has marked. Quite unfortunate. Carl asks if I am coming to rescue Louis. I think not. I will assist Li Na and keep him apprised. I drink a potion. Quite the day. Then I dismount, walk up to him, and inform him that I will hug him now, fellow warrior. I scream.

beats.headline: Out of Li Na's reach
beats.text: We did not find them. There were eighteen she marked, and three survived long enough to get away, and we now know who and where they are. It is not good news for Li Na. I drink another potion. That savage orc King Rust brought his harem into the dungeon on a deal with the AI, as non-combatants who could not be conscripted. They were caught in the ball but not as enemies, so Li Na could mark them. Three reached the Desperado Club and went through the Cosmic Lounge, back to the 18th floor. She will never heal.

beats.headline: Do not let them fall
beats.text: A warning, since nobody else has thought of it. Do not come in last, obviously. But do not kill your opponents either, and help any straggler who has fallen. The pool for each heat is fixed. Lose one team and it is fine; lose two and they must mix in the leftovers of other heats, and the leftovers may well be crawlers. I fear whole races of crawler against crawler. I chose biological, naturally. One would have to be an imbecile to have picked mechanical. Carl and the cat picked mechanical.

beats.headline: Sweety
beats.text: Our mount is named Sweety. She is a Perriso, a large-mount mammal similar to the tapir, big enough to carry me, this oaf, and one or two mercenaries. The oaf calls her a giant elephant pig and says we should have chosen mechanical, because he is a mechanic. He did mention that before I chose. It was irrelevant. Now he is buying mystery meat from a stall with no health inspection certificate, because some foods raise a mount's speed, and I have warned him about gastrointestinal distress. I am, as ever, correct. Observe the sidewalk.

beats.headline: A biscuit and a question about a girl
beats.text: I have a conundrum, and I bring it to the table. Three enriched biscuits came out of a celestial box, and one of them is the Paramour. Her name is Ragazzaccia. She was my girlfriend before the dungeon began, and she is still a goat; the other two biscuits would leave her one. Donut says absolutely not, and says it several times, and offers me rules to live by. She is right. It is too late. I do not have anybody else to ask these things.

beats.headline: Thrown out for outside drinks
beats.text: Celine Dion first charted in Canada in 1981, in French. Somebody in this bar had to know. I carry perhaps two hundred sodas from the diner, each with a different buff, each with its own straw, and I have told Jurgen he may eat nowhere else. The gremlin behind the counter objects to outside drinks in a drinking establishment. I scream at him. He falls over. I will not frequent an establishment where I am not wanted, so I leave it.

beats.headline: In praise of the secretions
beats.text: Half a bottle of the bat creatures' secretions buys about thirty minutes of protection from most environments. It is a superior and versatile product, and I cannot understand why it must be drunk by hand. Louis compares the taste to something from Miami. I would not know. I had the water park tunnels entirely mapped, and now my heat is rolled into the jungle. Sweety will be most upset. Take no wrong turn in those tubes. They come quickly.

beats.headline: He has read up on Chachi
beats.text: The analog in your culture, since you ask, is the Aztec goddess of the same name. Benevolent, supposedly, in a civilisation that practised human sacrifice, and the origin of a flood myth because she cried for many days. It is somewhat interesting how closely these gods track your pantheons. I, too, intend to enter this guild. I will be performing "In the Air Tonight" by Phil Collins. The cat's number is a surprise and a duet, and Carl requires potions and scrolls to survive it. That sounds like a hoot.

beats.headline: A delight, this place
beats.text: Somebody must ask the only question that matters, so I ask it. How will we know? She leaves Zhang's party, and a note may never arrive. A cactus, it transpires. Keep it somewhere safe, I tell them, and it still looks to me like a surefire suicide method. Good luck, Li Na. On my way out I concede the guild has improved. Pet stables. A Bopca. I declined to attach my personal space before; perhaps now. I have a karaoke kit, bought to practise for a performance that never happened. The cat gasps.

beats.headline: Sweety, rockets and a goat
beats.text: The plan is mine, and it is simple, so naturally the humans needed it explained. Once their shield is down, Bianca takes the half-mantaur out of the back of the Pontiac, delivers him to Carl, and returns to us. Sweety carries Jurgen and me through the air on her burning feet, and I put two volleys of rockets into the Dominators' car as it leaves the room. Shield is down. Bianca moves in. I do not require thanks. I require the others to keep up.

beats.headline: How to stop a slag elemental
beats.text: Everybody, attend. These elementals regenerate from the river, so killing them is a waste of effort, and I do not waste effort. They can, however, be delayed. It sounds counterintuitive, which is presumably why none of you thought of it: add any non-molten metal to one and it collapses at once back into the river, and must wait for that metal to melt before it can attack again. I am on the wall track with Jurgen, moving slower than I care to, and I have had time to watch. You are welcome.

beats.headline: A little stinky butt
beats.text: The crystal lives around my neck, and Carl may observe it. He may not keep it. Memorial Crystal, Apito, zero per cent charged. Osvaldo wore it and it did nothing; he kept it in inventory and it did nothing; then, near the end of Faction Wars, it shone into the sky on its own. It should not exist, since Apito is not dead. My god's quest says only to hold it, and I will know when to use it. The cat asks what my mother would have called me. A little stinky butt.

beats.headline: His mother, had she gone
beats.text: This is my mother if she had never stayed to care for her parents. A concert pianist in New York. She would never have known me. I did not get to sing, and nobody said they were sorry. Imani did not want me in the guild. I wish I had never taken the pet biscuit. Carl tells me Miriam is alone up there, and that we are a herd. It is a crude argument. It works. I embrace him, and then I tell the oaf to drive. Carl. You may call me Pony.

beats.headline: He calls it a nonevent
beats.text: The line into the Outreach Guild is gone and I believe nobody else will take a deal. Fewer than three hundred of us remain. A somber day. I have analysed Carl's plan, and I am confident this last race will be a nonevent, an anticlimax after the rest of the floor. For stating the obvious, the cat tells me, with nothing but love in her heart, to shut up, and I scream in the street. Carl assures me something horrible will happen at any moment. Then we do our good-race hug.

beats.headline: Three looted vehicles and a theme
beats.text: An ice-cream truck, an airport stair truck and a battered Tundra. I looted every one of them out of somebody else's garage, and now they are ours. Our theme is Vengeance. I have ideas. Carl's plan puts gods in this arena and we do not know its size, so they may arrive huge, and we should design accordingly, and the cat is shouting about papier-mache. We do not have time for papier-mache. She has druid spells. Let her make real flowers bloom.

beats.headline: In the Air Tonight
beats.text: The script called for a stinging statement about the downtrodden rising to devour those who revel in our suffering. Instead I sing. In the Air Tonight, the song I was never called up to sing at the bar, and Sweety stops dead in the judging area and pounds out the beat with her feet. The cat says I am ruining everything and that the song is about a divorce. Carl says it is appropriate. Carl is correct. Jurgen says I never tell him anything. I don't.

beats.headline: The god stole my crystal
beats.text: I will recover. I was electrocuted; I am now fine. Tend to Jurgen. The deity stole my memorial crystal, pulled it right off my neck, and I have filed a formal complaint with the Epicure. It was charging up with every one of her attacks and it was our protection, and we lost any floor boss prize too. The gods are level 250. Carl says that is why we will not face them one-on-one. Then he sends me a party request.

entities.name: Li Na

tagline.text: My brother and Zhang were pulled onto a live game show on the second floor, and the rest of us were frozen between the troglodytes and the Brindled Vespas. Then a man with a cat decided to interfere, and he got us all out.

On the card floor I run my own squad, and we have made it to the church along with Katia's, Elle's and Imani's. I take what I am given and do not ask what it costs. That is the rule I made for this floor.
My dread lives in a cactus in their guildhall. It tells them whether each of them is alive, and it tells me everything, all the time. I do not need to be with them to know.

entities.voiceNote: Few words, all of them chosen. Flat declaratives, no adjectives she does not need, no jokes. My brother for Li Jun; Carl; the cat. States what she will do and does not explain it. Never asks for help, never raises her voice, never says she is afraid.

beats.headline: Death Watch Extreme Dungeon Mayhem
beats.text: The show is Death Watch Extreme Dungeon Mayhem. The host calls himself the Maestro. He pulls my brother and Zhang off the floor and makes them play a guessing game for points that buy lives, and they will not choose which of us to spend them on. The rest of us stay frozen where we were standing, between the troglodytes and the Brindled Vespas. Then the crawler with the cat, Carl, decides he is too valuable to the production to be punished, and bets on it, out loud, and the four of us walk out. I am remembering his face.

beats.headline: Bait the boss through the hole
beats.text: Carl has saved my brother and me twice. I thank him, and the cat. Then I ask for the whole plan before we move, in case he dies and we must carry it on. Raise the cart a foot. Make the province boss on the other side of the noodle attack; it hits the portal and goes to the abyss. That gives us one more place to fall back to. He calls it fantastic. He offers a high five. If I touch someone with my hand, they feel excruciating pain throughout their body and lose control of bladder and bowels. I tell him so.

beats.headline: Easier to handle this way
beats.text: Carl goes into the trainyard behind a summoning. Katia and Elle draw the god away. The rest of us jump in front of the portal cart and come through the wall, and I bring the second vessel. Only the torso and head. I took off the lower body and the arms and healed him after each cut; it cost a few potions. The same idea as Carl's gnoll. He is easier to handle this way, and we can throw him into the portal instead of risking another accident. Carl should start punching.

beats.headline: Ten in the open, five in the pub
beats.text: Ten hunters on the south side of town, preparing to leave. One anti-air gun, spelled against targeting. Mostly level 50; one 53, one 63 in magical plate, possibly human. One rifle. Five mushroom guards. Maybe five more in the pub at the centre, Cold Stone Creamery. No sign of Vrah. My race sees who is bound to a god, and what god if I am close. The rifle carries the mark. I am not close enough to name it.

beats.headline: Kill her
beats.text: I go with Katia. Eva is under the dead bugs, unconscious, almost out of health. I cast Preserve Injury so she cannot heal herself, and I point at the ring on her top right hand. Katia cuts it off. Eva wakes and asks to be healed. Katia laughs. My brother looks from Katia to me. Kill her, I say.

beats.headline: A dragon, and a faster draw
beats.text: Beijing. The Galaxy Soho building, with hundreds of crawlers in it. Imani asks whether Chris is still with us. He is. My robe has an upgrade, and my chain-throwing is better for it. My brother and I are hunting a dragon now. A real one, from Chinese myth. And I have a mystic card that cuts the draw time from ten seconds to five.

beats.headline: Her squad reaches the church
beats.text: The church. Katia's squad is there, and Elle's, and Imani's, and mine. Four squads in one building, which does not happen by accident on this floor. It happened because Lucia handed round Doggy Door upgrades before she went down the stairs, and we used them. I take what I am given and I do not ask what it costs. That is the rule I made for this floor. I know what it says about me.

beats.headline: Recruited, at last
beats.text: Mordecai brews a potion that negates auras, and with it I can be recruited. I am. The moment it is done, I ask one thing: my squad builds the defences in and around Shanty Town. Carl agrees. The town is a ring around Larracos now, and it belongs to the Posse.

beats.headline: Did it work?
beats.text: A wire runs from my clock tower into Club Vanquisher, and my aura runs down it. Dark Purpose first. It is not meant to be used like this. It leveled faster than we anticipated, from four to fifteen, and I moved on. White chains are dragging the ghosts into the floor. Carl wants to know what that was, whether I knew, whether they are trapped somewhere. I ask him again. Did it work? Now I am using Defile Soul. Next I will train Bleeding Horror. I am cycling my dreads and leveling them all.

beats.headline: I need to train
beats.text: Carl wants the first dread back on, and the cat shouts at me to do what he says. I will if I have to. I need to train, and I cannot give up this opportunity. When they extend their claws, they bleed, and that should be enough once the dread trains high enough. It is level five and rising. Carl is marked as an ally; the blood will not hurt him. I suggest the berserker plan. At the portal he warns me his tattoo spell will hurt. I am ready. Blood Horror is level fifteen. I turn on my last dread: Succulent Decay.

beats.headline: Everyone once a tattoo
beats.text: Eris casts Bear Witness, and most of Shanty Town is affected. Those of us inside structures are fine. My brother is with me. Zhang was outside. Florin and all of the 101st are affected. Anyone who was once a tattoo is unaffected. The sluggalos too. Then she casts Bring Forth the Witnesses, and everyone who froze rises into the air and is gone, and no long-range teleport works on this floor for an hour.

beats.headline: My brother's eye
beats.text: Donut, do not break the ball apart. Donut asks where I am. I was installing my brother's eye into myself. I also stopped the mage who was going for Harpocrates. I am not strong enough yet to stop the god on my own. The deflector towers have paused him, and he will push past them to reach Donut. I suggest you run.

beats.headline: Take it
beats.text: The front of my face is blood. I have gouged out my own eye and put my brother's in its place. Carl starts to say he is sorry. I stop him. I give him the potion he asked me to take off the dead war mage, or a copy of it: I used Jun's scroll of potion duplication. The original is for Harpocrates. Then I will save Zhang, Elle, Katia and the others before they too fall victim to your chaos. He says it could kill me. I go.

beats.headline: All I can build
beats.text: The cat's paw hangs over Shanty Town, full of them. My chains go out from the tower. Dozens. Onto the wreckage around me, onto the Nest. A lattice. I tell the cat it is all I can build. Do it. She brings the paw down through it. The paw passes. They do not, until they do. Chains break. I grow more. She brings it down again. And again. Until the screaming stops.

beats.headline: Three hundred, across the board
beats.text: The System announces my strength at three hundred. Then my intelligence. Then all of them, charisma included, and says it has no plan for this. Level eighty-seven. I marked every enemy in the ball before the paw came down. Several did not die. Both warlords among them. I go through the castle. The war mages open a portal and are gone. Carl asks how many got away. Several, I tell him, including both warlords. There are unaffiliated outworlders here too. Where did they come from?

beats.headline: I am no child to protect
beats.text: Zhang apologises that it was my brother and not him. There is nothing to apologise for. I am no child to protect. I never have been. He has been a good friend to me, and Jun loved him like a brother. I will do this. I will clear the way for everyone who comes after the next race, and I will make certain the war mages do not turn on us. Do not die, Zhang. Do not ever lose your smile. I used to smile at him so that he would smile back. I tell him so. Then I am ready.

beats.headline: The Garden of Deliverance
beats.text: It works. The transfer holds, and they come across to the Pineapple Cabaret one after another, and my Dread watches over each of them from the moment they arrive. They are calling it the Garden of Deliverance. I do not need to see them to know they are alive. The Dread tells me. It tells me everything, all the time, and it does not stop.

entities.name: Florin

tagline.text: I'm fourth on the board: crocodilian, Shotgun Messenger, level twenty-four, three hundred thousand. I'd have preferred to stay a name nobody had learned yet. Too late for that.
Ifechi and I travel together now. The rest of that party is gone.
There's more than one of her in that head, and some of them are children. Whatever is happening to Lucia, the dog is at the centre of it.

entities.voiceNote: Steady, plain, low-volume. Reports what he saw and what he did, not what he feels, and stops when the report is done. Lucia is Lucia; everyone else by name. Never dramatises, never asks for help, never calls a thing impossible.

beats.headline: Fourth on the board
beats.text: They put the leaderboard up tonight and I am on it. Fourth. Crocodilian, Shotgun Messenger, level twenty-four, three hundred thousand. I don't know what they showed to get me there. I wasn't doing anything I would call footage. I would have preferred to stay a name nobody had learned yet. Too late for that.

beats.headline: Ife, and the warehouse
beats.text: Lucia blocked the stairs and set the dogs on me, and I fired. At her, at both dogs, again and again. None of it hurt them. Ife was against the wall with her head gone. She'd cast her protection on me and on a stranger and kept none for herself. The dungeon gave me the kill; there's a gold skull over my head for it. In the warehouse I sat down in the corner with her leech staff across my lap. I didn't spin anything. I leaned my head on the wall and went to sleep.

beats.headline: Everybody else in the bubble is dead
beats.text: I finally come out into a quadrant. Everybody else in my bubble is already dead. Not most of them. All of them. That leaves the castles, and one man to take them. I have cleared one so far. I am working my way through the rest. The general view is that I am screwed. I keep going.

beats.headline: The last rescue of phase one
beats.text: I took three of the castles on my own. The air one I could not. I was the last rescue of the first phase; I have the club because of Ifechi. Before the stairs I came to meet Carl. I was done. I had nothing. Then Elle told me about a man and his cat who stopped everything to help old people in wheelchairs, and meant to use an artifact to get people out of their bubbles. Ife was not the only good one. I might die tomorrow, but not because I have given up. If he ever needs a backup gun, I am in his debt.

beats.headline: He asks if Lucia lived
beats.text: I am in the back corner of Carl's space when he and Donut come in from the fight. I ask the one thing I want to know. Lucia survived? I did not see a notification. Donut says yes, that she's a cheater like Quan Ch and she got away. Good, I say. I push off the wall and go out into the guildhall common area. They all watch me go.

beats.headline: Gear I can't wear
beats.text: Two Goriffs, blue, trunks on their heads. Pulse rifles and electric armor. The armor didn't cover their faces. I have their gear now and I can't equip any of it. It's locked to the dead owners. Mordecai says that's common on sponsor items. There's a scroll called Cracker Jack that frees it, and nobody has one. We keep collecting. Carl's still talking. Quit jawing and get on with it.

beats.headline: Lucia Mar is mine
beats.text: Carl's plan goes round on the paper in the bathroom and everyone signs it. Goal five is kill Lucia Mar, because she is too dangerous and a wildcard. I sign under it. I am claiming Lucia Mar for myself. If someone attempts to stop me, we will have a problem. That is the whole of what I write.

beats.headline: He will not go down the stairs
beats.text: The queen has Ifechi's face. Katia says it's her twin sister, and she warns me. Carl reminds me of the rule we all agreed to: if Imogen took the form of someone's loved one, that person goes down the stairs. I tell him to go fuck himself. I don't see his cat going down the stairs. I tell him to back off. I'm fine. I've been pacing for an hour, waiting for this party.

beats.headline: What is inside Lucia
